critic.quote: Ender Lilies is an emotional sidescroller RPG with a well-told compelling story, beautiful music & art, and solid gameplay. Its hauntingly beautiful style and satisfying world more than makes up for some slight combat blemishes, leaving a lasting impression as one of the most remarkable games of its kind.

Ender Lilies: Quietus of the Knights is a very atmospheric game, full of feelings and emotions. It is beautifully terrifying and terribly beautiful, allowing players to admire the destroyed cathedral and crumbling statues, a decayed village, a flooded temple of magic and other charmingly gloomy locations.

Ender Lilies: Quietus of the Knights is that rare example of a game that melds classic game design with modern narrative sensibilities. It's at once a slice of platforming, exploration and combat that'll feel familiar to all, while also tacking mature themes with every beat. It's a treat to play, a sight to behold, and well worth your time.

ENDER LILLIES manages to mitigate my issues with the Metroidvania subgenre while surpassing any expectations I had thanks to its story, art, and gameplay. My time with it was so overwhelmingly positive that I found myself struggling to pinpoint things I didn’t like. To those (like myself) who found themselves enamored with Valkyrie Profile’s theater-of-tragedy style of storytelling, I highly recom

Ender Lilies doesn’t revolutionize Metroid’s decades-old template, but that’s okay. It’s a well-made experience, and I had a great time pouring over two dozen hours into this adventure. The presentation rocks, the action is more rewarding than punishing, and its gothic world and lore are alluring. Ender Lilies is a great meat and potatoes experience, demonstrating that simply executing a familiar

With a rich and pleasant gameplay, a really neat artistic direction and a fairly well balanced challenge (a little less at the end of the adventure), Ender Lilies ticks all the boxes of the successful 2D action-RPG. critic.quote: I question if it goes too far to say this is the best single-player experience I've ever had on my GCN. No boring moments like "Metroid Prime," no extreme tedium like "Wind Waker." It's like a roller coaster that never goes up, only down.

I have never had so much fun getting into a game as I have had with Resident Evil 4. Everything is just perfect about this game. The storyline, the graphics, the sound, the fear the game gives you. It is a A+ effort from Capcom.
The hit zone-based targeting system, for example, makes anything else in the genre seem obsolete and primitive. It's that sophisticated.

Resident Evil 4 displays such extreme mastery of the videogame medium that it deserves far more than any review could give it, which essentially makes the thousands of sycophantic words we've just battered out redundant.

A majestic work of gaming art, a true virtual masterpiece that simply must be played to be truly believed... It is apparent to me that this was a project that was loved from the moment it was dreamt up and that sense of caring simply shines through like a beacon in the darkness.

The combat gameplay is unrivaled, especially during some of the very creative boss battles. It's also the longest Resident Evil game yet, with 25 - 30 hours of gameplay on two discs along with a ton of unlockables that will make you want to do it all over again.

With seamless gameplay and fighting mechanics, 40 hours of exploration will seem like no time has gone by and it will leave you wanting more time running the glistening streets of Shibuya.

Ghostwire: Tokyo is a brilliant experiment in the clash of style and substance. Tokyo exists as an open world reminiscent of older games whose design may now feel ancient. When Ghostwire: Tokyo capitalises on its spooky surroundings by whisking you off into strange dimensions, fighting evil with powers you shoot from your hands, it’s excellent. critic.quote: Warhammer: Chaosbane is an absolute treat for fans of the Warhammer universe. If you like dungeon crawlers or Warhammer in general, you should definitely pick this up – especially if you don't have a phone. Be sure to check out the full review above for an exciting look at Warhammer: Chaosbane, which should absolutely be on your radar when it comes to Game of the Year considerations later in 2019.
Despite some controller woes, Warhammer Chaosbane delivers a solid and robust action RPG experience that is certain to delight both hardcore and casual fans of the genre alike.
Warhammer Chaosbane walks in the footsteps of Diablo, but fails to match it's master because of the repetitive environments, it's shot lifetime and an extremely limited endgame content.
The mission design and story can grate at times, but this is a devilishly fun homage to Diablo 3 and Warhammer Fantasy you’ll want to get your friends in on.
The artwork at the beginning of each act is beautifully drawn. The music is also quite powerful and foreboding as it sets the mood for the game.

Thanks to its simple formula, Warhammer: Chaosbane is an easy-to-play hack’n’slash, but it really lacks some more variety. This game is not aimed at the  big lootheads but to a more casual audience, and it shows.

s.desc:
体验《影子武士3》的最终版，享受穿越神话日本国度的快节奏枪战、锋利近战和壮观自由奔跑移动的超暴力融合体验。在生存模式、二周目和硬核难度中测试你的技能，当心那条龙！
堕落企业将军王洛和他昔日的死对头大蛇齐拉在血腥俏皮的FPS系列最新作品《影子武士3》中回归。执行一个不可能完成的任务，抓捕被王洛无意地从永恒监狱中释放出的一条古龙，用刀刃和子弹组成的火爆武器库在恶魔滋生的破碎土地上杀出一条路来。
新特色包括：二周目模式，带来了额外的挑战、武器皮肤和奖励；生存模式，允许你在面对一波又一波的敌人时测试你的技能；一个新的英雄模式游戏调节项，提供更大的挑战；章节选择模式，让你可以快速重玩；最后还有硬核难度，提供迄今为止最艰难版本的影子武士！
带着武士刀参加枪战
冲散恶魔大军，通过混合压倒性的火力和精准致命的武士刀劈斩，在每场遭遇战中指挥演奏死亡交响曲。
神行百变
交替运用花样百出的敏捷移动技术，包括有空中突进、飞檐走壁、二段跳和新增的酷炫抓钩，在每场战斗中获得大量的战斗和移动选项。
处决杀戮
执行壮观的终结技，取得你征服的敌人的一部分，用其力量打击敌军，释放不可阻挡的狂怒和强大的魔法。
动态战斗竞技场
每个环境都布满了可被激活的危险建筑和设备，为进攻策略添加了另一层创造性的选择。
新封建日本
穿越一片充满古代武士魔法和技能，现正被日本民间传说中的恶魔妖怪蹂躏的神话亚洲土地。
插科打诨
准备好迎接来自王洛的娴熟俏皮话，与齐拉之间尖锐的嬉笑怒骂，以及撑过荒谬困境，将末日变成崭新一天的紧张刺激之旅。
王洛之道！
生存模式是一个全新的游戏模式，允许你游玩3个新的战斗竞技场，享受多个小时的新玩法！那些能够完成挑战的人能解锁3个新的武器皮肤！完成游戏后生存模式就会开放！
重温美妙时刻！
章节选择菜单允许让你返回收集错过的升级点数，以及按照你中意的任何顺序重温一些定义了你与王洛的冒险的最爱时刻！
给王洛点好彩头！
二周目模式提供了一种新的游戏方式。享受额外的挑战和奖励，以及让王洛找回自信的皮肤！
玩的就是难度！
新的硬核难度会让你体验最艰难版本的影子武士！胆小者勿近。
死绝删档
在全新的英雄模式中测试你的技能。这是一个具有挑战性的调节项，会让你游玩时有生命数限制，并通过表演花哨的终结技来赚取更多的生命。用完生命，就永远失去进度。

critic.quote: Shadow Warrior 3 is an unbridled good time with great fights and even greater one-liners. Add in some character and weapon upgrades with a great store and that is a recipe for success in my book. With the exception of the controller issues everything else in this game comes highly recommended by myself.

Shadow Warrior 3 is a fun shooter that falls short of greatness. The combat is fast and frantic, and it is intense enough that I found myself getting lost in it. The short length, lack of variety, and inevitable comparisons to Doom Eternal don't do it any favors. I am glad that I played Shadow Warrior 3, and I imagine a lot of folks will feel the same way. It might be best to wait for a price drop
I love Lo Wang so much. So much! He’s truly the best third-grade ninja in circulation! That’s why it’s a shame that the combat arenas are effectively the same throughout the whole campaign.

Shadow warrior 3 is an excellent first person shooter with an awesome combat system full of possibilities and cool mechanics, with gorgeous and colorful graphics that looks outstanding. The poor and simple level design, short length and lack of content avoid it from reaching the top tiers of the genre.
Pretty, action-packed, and fun while it lasts, Shadow Warrior 3 is well made as long as there isn't any dialogue, but there's so little content that the price tag makes it truly hard to recommend.

Shadow Warrior 3 feels like a teenager that still has a bit of maturing to do. Humor that tries to be edgy overshadows the fun gameplay, and the lack of an intriguing story does not help either. I would not necessarily say Shadow Warrior 3 is a bad game, but it was disappointing that I often felt like I was playing through a 15-year-old’s video game fantasy. critic.quote: This is exactly the kind of revolutionary title that we applaud. Sure, others like it will come along, some will even surpass it, but hats off to Resident Evil for getting there first.

Long the lord of Street Fighter, Capcom's clearly taking a new tack with this killer game, and the results are outstanding. Resident Evil stands tall as a topnotch second-generation PlayStation game that's well worth the green.
Stunning graphics. Amazing sounds. Gripping storyline. Frightening enemies. Callenging gameplay.

One of the most important aspects to Resident Evil is the music and sound effects – both of which are nothing short of captivating and involving. The horror sounds and shills of zombies and hounds will keep the hair on the back of your neck full staff and your butt on the edge of your seat.
Fantastic game, but who can forget the terrible intro and dialogue? [Jan 2004, p.189]
Never has a game combined excellent graphics with heart-stopping action and a great story in such a way as to create an almost cinematic adventure... A masterpiece.

critic.quote: The Evil Within is a true return to form. Not just for Shinji Mikami, but for the whole survival horror genre this is a great title. Anyone that grew up with games like Resident Evil or Silent Hill will be enjoying this game to the fullest.
It's worth playing through at least once — and if you're into it, again with New Game +.
The Evil Within isn't without some glaring shortcomings, but overall, this is survival horror at its most brutally rewarding. A triumphant return for Shinji Mikami.
While The Evil Within doesn’t quite reach the iconic Resident Evil 4‘s level of brilliance or scariness, this is a satisfyingly gruesome adventure.
After a clumsy opening, The Evil Within hits its stride towards the end and the fist act and the tension rarely lets up. [Christmas 2014, p.114]

Unfair difficulty spikes swap out the title’s pervading sense of fear for outright frustration at times, while technical issues undo the developer’s outstanding art direction. Thankfully, legendary director Shinji Mikami doesn’t disappoint in the gameplay department, forcing you to get creative with your plentiful combat options due to an unending absence of resources.

s.desc:
你不该来这里！
曾为66号公路必打卡路边景点的道尔顿恐龙乐园，如今在新墨西哥州的烈日炙烤下，弥漫着诡谲的气息。所有员工不知所踪，但你在园区里找到的电话却传来了一个神秘的声音，苦苦哀求你帮忙寻找一个失踪的孩子。
若不是你的车在这前不着村后不着店的地方抛锚的话……你早走了。现在是1992年，没有手机，没有网约车，也寻求不到救援。很快你就会发现，园区内不止你一人。
你将遭遇形貌可怖的怪物，它们会追捕你、围猎你、折磨你。趁现在还能喘气就多吸两口吧，因为这可能是你最后的喘息。
狂奔、攀爬、求生。
《恐怖蜥蜴》是一款融合恐怖元素和第一人称跑酷的游戏，将为你带来易于上手但难于精通的残酷追逐体验。
在废弃恐龙展馆里游荡的生物已经盯上了你。它们看似行动蹒跚，却会突然向你猛扑过来。为了活下去，你必须奔跑、跳跃、攀爬、跑墙、弹跳和滑铲。在这里，你手无寸铁，只能依靠智慧脱险。
特色玩法
——当恐怖遇上跑酷：利用基于动量的流畅跑酷动作，甩开那些势不可挡的怪物。
——深埋地下的谜团：探索这座荒废的路边景点，找出隐藏在地下的梦魇。
——手无寸铁：凭借智慧和机动性战胜追击者，正面交锋绝非出路。
——环境叙事：收集磁带、笔记和录音，揭开道尔顿恐龙乐园背后的骇人真相。

critic.quote: Terrible Lizards is a terrific parkour-filled trip through 90s nostalgia.
Terrible Lizards carves itself a unique spot in the genre as a creature feature horror game centred on parkour that fans of cheese will get a huge kick out of.

Terrible Lizards is an impressive horror-platforming debut that blends fluid Titanfall 2-style parkour with tense dinosaur chases, memorable set pieces, and strong atmosphere. Its story and characters never quite reach the same heights, but the six-to-eight-hour adventure delivers plenty of adrenaline for speedrunners and explorers alike.

It may not achieve the frictionless perfection of Mirror’s Edge, but Terrible Lizards is a competent and fun parkour platformer that has enough hints of genuine dread and tension that it propels itself above the mean.

critic.quote: Knocking it out of the park once again, San Diego Studio continues to make MLB The Show 26 a premier sports sim.

MLB The Show 26 from developer San Diego Studio and publisher Sony Interactive Entertainment is a solid improvement from last year’s game, with more data inclusion, smoother career decision-making, and better backend gameplay refinements. While not a huge leap from the previous year, it’s still a good release with enough reason to consider it, especially if you’re a new player who doesn’t have las

MLB The Show 26 once again confirms the series’ solidity. It doesn’t revolutionize the formula, but it improves it in several key aspects, offering an extremely refined and content-rich sports experience. For baseball fans, it remains simply the most complete simulation available today.

Still, MLB The Show 26 comes down to playing ball, and in that sense, it still remains capable of draining away chunks of your day (or week). Few sports games have done as well in mastering the soul of its sport. The pacing, tension, and strategy of the game translate wonderfully, and it's still the best day at the gaming ballpark you can find.

If you played MLB The Show 25, you can probably skip MLB The Show 26, but if you are someone that didn't check out last year's version, the new game will likely provide more value. MLB The Show 26 is iterative, not essential, and while it delivers fantastic core gameplay and enough content to keep hardcore baseball fans busy for hours on end, the franchise could definitely benefit from a more sign

MLB The Show 26 retains the series reputation as a fun game of baseball. If you've never played a baseball game before, you won't be disappointed. If you have, it's hard to ignore the shortcomings. The visuals are dated and need an overhaul, which hopefully will come in the next generation of consoles. 欢迎来到ParadiZe！
你想拥有自己的丧尸伙伴吗？想拥有一个忠实的朋友，它保护你不被其他丧尸伤害，陪伴你完成所有的冒险？在ParadiZe，我们把这变成了现实！在这里，所有脏活累活都交给丧尸来干。
在美丽的ParadiZe国，天才的幸存者们正在测试一种技术，这种技术可以用来控制肆虐全球的丧尸。一旦被控制，丧尸就变成了宝贵的盟友，尽管它们并不十分聪明，有时还很不稳定。
ParadiZe并不都是美好的，但如果你足够聪明灵巧，也许就能生存下来……
充满惊喜的目的地
探索ParadiZe，结识个性鲜明的非凡人物。奇特的动植物会处处带来惊喜。可以选择独自上路或与Zombot伙伴一起，踏上雪地或沙漠的冒险之旅。请放心地清除任何试图干扰你与我们在一起的害虫。
想去野外探险，还是想在营地里闲逛？根据自己的喜好来选择吧！
不过，我们建议不要与当地人走得太近：他们可能有些……好斗。
甜蜜家园
来到这里后不久，你就必须建造自己的营地，这是个舒适的小窝，可以进行逐步升级。舒适度固然重要，但也别忘了架设防御！添加多个陷阱和防御工事用以击退丧尸，因为丧尸有个坏习惯，就是永远不会放过你。
维护营地需要付出努力，但如果你不喜欢这些琐碎的工作，也不用担心：正如我们之前所说，这里的脏活累活都是丧尸干的。
越多越快乐……
你可以在这里当个独行侠，也可以与其他人往来。
你最多可邀请三位朋友，让他们和你一起享受这难忘的体验。
ParadiZe会张开双臂欢迎所有人！
怎么样？还等什么？

critic.quote: ParadiZe doesn't take itself too seriously and takes the zombie theme lightly. It's one of those games that offers a mix of genres and if you don't accept them as a whole, you simply won't fully appreciate the game. Either take it all together and have fun, or leave it alone.
I haven't had this much fun in a co-op game since It Takes Two.
Not bad, not great: Welcome to ParadiZe is a fun pastime that made me want to play more Diablo IV.
Welcome to ParadiZe has a great sense of humour and super satisfying combat and crafting systems that elevate it above the surface jank.

Welcome to ParadiZe has a great core concept that is just shy of fully capitalizing on. I think it could have been a serious winner if the game had leaned more heavily into its base-building and crafting identity. As it stands, it is more of an okay ARPG title that, while definitely full of some interesting mechanics, isn’t the most exciting one on the market.
Welcome to ParadiZe is an ok game if you can deal with the repetitive combat. You’re basically just R1’ing through zombie waves much of the game.

s.desc:
由《直到黎明》和《采石场惊魂》制作团队倾情打造的全新电影式科幻恐怖冒险游戏，将紧张刺激的生存游戏玩法、影响故事走向的选择，以及多分支故事情节融为一体。
地球正在走向终结，人类的时间已所剩无几。距离地球12光年的天仓五f星是最后一线希望。当殖民飞船仙后号在这颗星球紧急着陆后，他们很快就发现自己不是唯一的访客。
一种能够模仿受害者的外星生物体入侵了仙后号，只有识破狡猾的狩猎者，船员们才能活着回家。在为生存而战时，他们面临着最艰难的抉择：想要活命，就会威胁到全人类的存亡。
游戏特色：
次世代电影式生存恐怖游戏
好莱坞演员拉什娜·林奇（代表作《鲍勃·马利：一份爱 》《达荷美女战士》）扮演成就卓越的宇航员“杨”，在拯救人类的深空任务中，体验身临其境的电影叙事，以及扣人心悬的紧张剧情。
实时外星生物威胁
外星生物就潜藏在飞船黑暗的角落中，意图消灭人类生命。你必须躲避无处不在的致命威胁，使用简易的武器、迅速的反应以及高超的潜行技术战胜敌人。
无人可信
遭遇能够完美模仿受害者的外星生命体。当敌人就隐藏在众目睽睽之下时，船员们多年的训练和信任将瞬间瓦解。到底谁才是人类？你的选择比任何时候都更加重要！
倒转决定
使用我们全新的转折点故事树，改写你的命运，改变故事走向，揭开多重结局，解锁隐藏路径，并从悲惨的死亡中夺回你的船员。
何必独自游玩
在本地合作电影之夜模式中，招募最多五名玩家加入你的任务。选择要控制的船员，与好友合作，从外星入侵者、致命困境和灾难性的系统故障中死里逃生。在线多人模式将在后续更新中推出。
在太空中，死亡有许多形式。

Directive 8020 is a major step forward for The Dark Pictures Anthology. The story is engaging, the production values are excellent, and the added gameplay mechanics make this the most interactive entry in the series so far. The stealth sections can become a bit repetitive, but they never get in the way of what is still a tense and highly entertaining sci-fi horror survival adventure.

With Directive 8020, Supermassive comes out of the gate strong: a compelling story with a solid, diverse cast that makes for a horror adventure that slowly unfolds. The formula of making choices and living with consequences is somewhat undermined by the Rewind feature. Given the claustrophobic and tense nature of this story, the emphasis on stealth gameplay is a very smart decision. By constantly

Supermassive Games leaves haunted houses and slashers behind to embrace cosmic horror in Directive 8020, a deep-space adventure heavily inspired by Alien and The Thing. The result is the studio's smartest branching narrative to date and its most beautiful production, held back only by repetitive stealth sequences and a few rough technical edges.
It's dingy and it's not without some mutations, but Directive 8020 is definitely worth exploring - just expect the mundane along the way.

The Dark Pictures Anthology resumes its journey grounded in certain constants—its horror roots, its focus on plot and character, and its narrative branching—but also introduces significant new elements, chief among them a fresh setting and revamped gameplay mechanics. 此礼包中包含的死神金属将作为赠品（免费货币）提供。
本作采用赛季重置机制。每个新季度开始时，玩家的剧情进度、侵略者等级、持有物品和专精都将被重置。
但是，死神金属、用其购买的内容以及版本中的大部分内容（如机身类型和装饰等）将得以保留。
——人类刚从一场史无前例的大灾难（大地之怒）中恢复过来，却又遭到了全新噩梦的侵袭。一个足以吞噬整座城市的“巨大洞穴”出现了。
巨洞深不见底，尽头通往何处亦无人知晓。前去调查的人员无一生还，不知从何时起，人们开始将它称作“地狱门”，并对此畏惧不已。
明知危险，本应远离巨洞，但洞中可开采的珍贵资源“超粒锂”与“某个传闻”，却让人心智狂乱。
“在巨洞的深处，沉睡着足以支配世界的超粒锂结晶——‘死神之眼’。”
当然，要得到它，就必须纵身跳入洞中，克服超乎想象的万般险阻。
阻挡在前的，是各种物质融合而成的异形怪物，是超乎常理的恐怖环境，以及被贪婪吞噬的人类。
“挡路者，格杀勿论。”
超大型企业四山集团无恶不作，暴虐无道。
地上是地狱，洞中亦是地狱。唯一的避难之所，就只有悬浮于空中的钢铁栖木。
反抗四山集团，死路一条。
但，不必畏惧。
因为你是“侵略者”——不死的冒险家。
无数次复活，不断更换躯体，在这条杀戮之路上狂奔吧。
从一万米高空的据点，向着地狱之洞，献上这死亡一跃。
为了获得不死之身，你舍弃了过去，斩断了所有羁绊。
放心，你并非孤身一人。
在侵略者协会，一群又酷又疯的家伙正在等着你。
身穿丧服的爱哭鬼接待员、独臂的怪力老太婆、戴着天狗面具的神秘大叔、堕入黑暗的连环画剧人、爱秀优越感的美女侵略者……剩下的人物就等你亲自去见识了。
那么，你打算怎么做，王牌侵略者？
是得到“死神之眼”并拯救世界吗？
还是化为永世游荡地狱的亡魂？
或是，命丧同伴之手？
一切都取决于你。
无畏的冒险家啊，世界的深渊正在呼唤着你。
战胜死神的挑战，从地狱的深渊中夺回未来！

critic.quote: Let It Die: Inferno stands out with its unique aesthetic, reaching the peak of kitsch style. The mix of extraction shooter and roguelite elements shows great promise, but the game is held back by its notably slow, heavy controls and an unpolished system.

The essence of a true B-grade game returns. Beneath its off-kilter weirdness lies combat that strikes at the core of action itself—distance control and psychological pressure. The title may insist you should ‘let it die,’ but ironically, it’s a descent into hell that makes you fight to live more desperately than ever.
The hardest of the hardcore will enjoy Let it Die: Inferno, but it might prove to be a hard sell for everyone else.

While Let It Die Inferno intrigues with its ideas and universe, it fails to play to its strengths to keep us engaged over the long term. Best enjoyed in small doses, thanks to its low price, but not at high intensity as extraction games generally require.

Inferno could have been a solid title if Supetrick put any sort of effort into actually improving the original game’s formula, but it instead comically doubles down on every single aspect that made it a chore to play, except now you have to pay an entry fee (which doesn’t mean microtransactions are gone, by the way). Let it Die: Inferno is a gorgeous and highly stylised game that can’t stop tripping over itself. critic.quote: Darkest Dungeon is one of the most intense and immersive games out there. A product of creative genius and flawless design, it delivers, with simplistic perfection, a difficult yet addictive experience.

Darkest Dungeon plays the long game. It builds you up for a grand bout that will test everything you've learned, as well as your ability to plan several in-game weeks out. The pay-off for this constant offensive comes in short bursts--just enough to keep you going, just enough to keep you hopeful for the next excursion. It's an extraordinary cycle that bears a special teacher--rewarding your cleve
There is a lot of grinding involved in this game, but the grind is generally pretty fun. It is surprisingly addictive and great to play in the wee hours of the night.
Darkest Dungeon's sanity system is worth the entire experience. Try it, but don't expect a good story or a traditional RPG.
It's a surprise to find that this relentless numerical tangle of a dungeon crawler is a human story. [March 2016, p.118]

Despite the grind, despite the perhaps undue commitment to brutality, and despite what I feel is a joke at the player's expense at the end, Darkest Dungeon still manages to be one of the most engaging and intriguing roguelikes I've ever played and I'll probably still be diving dungeons and trying new party compositions weeks from now. After all, it would be madness to stop at this point.

critic.quote: Green Hell is a fantastic survival experience with an exemplary sense of place and peril. Creepy Jar have really nailed the feeling of loneliness and despair that true isolation would lead to and married this to some well balanced challenges and a refreshingly user friendly approach. The range of ways to play are really welcome and should ensure that even those players who may be turned off by the

Overall if you are hankering for some pretend survival whilst we are all doing it for real with COVID 19 I would definitely recommend this game. Even if you just sit and enjoy the atmosphere I feel it is well worth the money.

Green Hell is a wild and spectacular indie survival because there is so much to do and a lot to risk at every step. It has intriguing mechanics, solid gameplay and extreme realism that blend well with the deadly Amazonian context, forcing the player to engage himself to not dying every 15 minutes. Some minor bugs and technical issues cannot ruin one of the most exciting experiences on the survival

If you look at it and can overlook the rather clumsy story and the weak fighting system, Green Hell is suitable for genre novices with strong nerves as well as for veterans interested in a new challenge.

Green Hell is a hardcore survival that will give you the atmosphere of wandering and surviving harsh Amazon jungle, all while posing an intriguing story to lead you onwards. Even though it does not possess multiplayer and suffers by being an average survival game in many regards, it will provide you with a few hours of quality fun, especially at this price range.

If games like The Forest were up your alley, I do recommend giving Green Hell a shot. However, if you’re easily frustrated by obscure deaths vs trial and error, I’d recommend starting out at the easier difficulty so you can enjoy what it has to offer without needing to wrestle in frustration.

critic.quote: Watch_Dogs combines an astonishingly detailed world, a gripping storyline, creative game mechanics, a myriad of missions and activities, and improvisational tactical sandbox gameplay to create a truly next-generation open world game. Phenomenal. No other word for it.

It raises social and governmental questions around a person’s right to privacy. It delivers combat, stealth, story, and an incredible amount of side content to bring the whole world to life. I’m amazed at what the team at Ubisoft has delivered here, and I’m glad that they treated the hacker world with more respect and attention to detail than any other game or movie to date.
Watch Dogs has dull characters spewing agonizing dialogue, but gameplay-wise it gets most of its ingredients right. Even the simplified hacking feels like something new. [June 2014]
Watch Dogs comes close to earning Best in Show, but falters on some critical open-world elements. Bring on the sequel! [July 2014, p74]

The main character has the charisma of a wet piece of cardboard, but other than that, Watch Dogs is solid and a great foundation for Ubisoft to build on in the future. Having spent many hours in virtual Chicago as Aiden Pearce, we’re only hungry for more.

The game is a sort of inverse of Grand Theft Auto 5: triumphant in ambition but faltering in execution. Nowhere is this more apparent than in those NPC bios, which can’t seem to decide if they’re funny or serious.

critic.quote: FC 27 rectifies many mistakes of the previous entries to the series and listens to what the community has been asking for many years. With manual gameplay at heart, skill comes to the forefront. Backed by new game modes and better overall balance, this game will be delightful for beginners and veterans alike.
Despite a series of stumbles and some worrying signs for the future, such as the much-hyped addition of the weak The Grounds, EA Sports FC 27 is still the best soccer simulator on the market.

EA SPORTS FC 27 may not be the graphical leap I was hoping for, partly because it is still being released on PS4 and Xbox One, but when it comes to gameplay, EA has listened to the fans. AI defending is no more, making the game much more rewarding to play.
EA Sports FC 27 shows improvements in every area, but the familiar grinding, microtransactions, and bugs on the field sadly remain.

I really liked playing FC 27 at times, even if I wished some things had improved to a greater degree and it was more ambitious. The experience is a familiar one that doesn’t change too much from its predecessor, but one that I’m going to continue to enjoy digging into.

EA Sports FC 27 excels in its accessible Ultimate Team mode and refined realistic gameplay settings, yet it suffers from significant neglect toward single-player experiences. Despite fluid animations and stable online performance, the title persists with recurring legacy bugs, an unoriginal social hub, and a chaotic, overly arcade-focused competitive meta.

critic.quote: NBA 2K27 turns out to be a very polished installment that knows how to listen to its fans. The debut of the NBA 2K HQ app is an excellent tool for managing your MyPLAYER and your team without needing to turn on the console, despite how tricky its face scan can be. On the other hand, the integration of AI and a more refined narrative make its story mode an exciting journey, perfect to enjoy even in

NBA 2K27 is a resounding success when it comes to basketball simulation. The arena atmosphere, the photorealistic graphics, and—above all—the challenging defensive gameplay make the offline experience a delight.

NBA 2K27 doesn’t cut the same shine that 2K26 did, but it still boasts best-in-class gameplay, and meaningful improvements in key areas. Still an easy recommendation for hoops fans, but the sheen is beginning to wear off a bit as we near the end of a generation.

NBA 2K27 takes meaningful steps toward improving the on-court experience, especially on defense, with more dynamic animations and a new cooperative experience. However, it still carries many of the franchise’s long-standing issues, including invasive microtransactions and pay-to-advance mechanics. Eras mode remains the crown jewel and is enough on its own to justify buying the game. For basketball

If your goal is to play quick matches, relive the glory days of the NBA, or simply hang out with friends on the court, 2K27 is the best NBA game released in recent years. However, if you want to dive deeper and get your money's worth by fully exploring every mode, you have to grind. Beyond that—whether you choose to grind or pay—the constant "Maybe you should buy some VC?" reminders are annoying i

critic.quote: Being a Final Fantasy fan has never been easier or more rewarding. While the mainline entries focus on pushing novelty, Final Fantasy Resonance bets on familiarity and years of learned design, delivering an experience that feels comforting yet refreshingly distinct.
There is a lot to love about Final Fantasy Resonance. Its charm is undeniable. Its great cast of characters, fantastic combat, and in depth customization help it stand out in a crowded field.

Final Fantasy Resonance may not reinvent the airship, but it incorporates every mainline Final Fantasy title—directly, as classic characters appear as Visions, or indirectly, through a story that draws from every installment. It’s a splendid celebration of the series ahead of its 40th anniversary.

Final Fantasy Resonance manages to transform its nod to the past into something more than a mere nostalgic exercise. The return to turn-based combat, the Stagger and Visions systems, and a highly refined HD-2D art style deliver a classic JRPG experience that feels anything but dated. Certain design choices—such as random encounters, backgrounds that don’t always hit the mark, and, most notably, th

The mix of new and old in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE makes for an engaging story with a visceral battle system and a world that's a joy to explore. However, I wish the visions mechanic was more central to the game and its writing can be eye-rolling at parts.

Final Fantasy Resonance is well-suited for both veterans of the franchise and newcomers to the JRPG genre. The gameplay is entertaining and varied. Visually, however, the stylishly designed HD-2D graphics alternate with 3D sequences that seem somewhat out of place.

critic.quote: Street Fighter 6 honestly feels like the best game of the series in every facet possible. The long term will prove or disprove this though as these games tend to morph and change over their lifetime. But for this game to take that title, it’s done everything right from the outset to cement its legacy as the best of the best. This game is a recommendation for people interested in fighting games at

Capcom may have made significant mistakes in the development of Street Fighter V, but it’s clear they were determined not to repeat them with Street Fighter 6. I can’t remember the last time a fighting game offered such a complete package, with something for every type of player. Combine that with best-in-class mechanics and a visual identity that truly sets it apart, and Street Fighter 6 is every

Capcom once again sets a new standard for 2D fighting games. In addition to the advanced combat system and the excellent package of single-player modes, made up of numerous elements that find their balance in sharing the same resource (the Drive indicator), SF6 counts on more than a vast group of tutorials and alternative control schemes for every need.

This is not only a kinetic, exciting and gloriously refined interpretation of the most storied fighting game series, but also the most generous and expansive offering yet. Here is a game that pays tearful tribute to its past, while determinedly seeking out a new and young audience - mindful, no doubt, that its future resides in their hands, be they practised or otherwise. [Issue #386, p.100]
Street Fighter 6 comes out of its corner swinging and delivers a three-hit combo of modes that will leave fight fans floored.
For fans of the series, Street Fighter 6 is an insta-buy. It’s an easy recommendation for fighting game fans at large too.

critic.quote: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve elevates the franchise to new heights with a spectacular campaign that mixes high octane missions with relevant thematic storytelling. The real ace, though, remains the compelling and addictive dogfighting gameplay.
Skies packed with enemies and a soundtrack that makes you feel invincible - Ace Combat is back in a big way.

Wings of Theve is a fantastic game worthy of a series that has been going strong for 30 years. With its striking visuals, immersive sense of warfare, and well-written characters, I can confidently say that it manages to take the series one step further in every respect.

Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is, so far, one of the best combat flight simulators out there, and among the finest in the franchise. It masterfully blends intense dogfights, gameplay depth, spectacular visuals, a diverse roster of aircraft, and a well-crafted online mode. It is clear that the series keeps its magic intact and its ability to surprise after 31 years.

For every modern combat aviation enthusiast, living out your own Top Gun story is surely the dream. Ace Combat 8 fulfils this dream to perfection — not just through excellent action, but also thanks to its story and characters. Just remember to don a pair of oversized aviator sunglasses every now and again to overlook the graphical flaws.

Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is yet another brilliant entry in the Ace Combat series, with a lengthy campaign and fun multiplayer. There are some minor annoyances, but once you're in the air dogfighting, they're easy to overlook.

Zenless Zone Zero blends simple-yet-stylish combat with a soundtrack that spans decades of musical flair. But although its audiovisual polish is outstanding and its combat is simple yet challenging, its shallow support roles and the removal of its unique exploration mode hold the game back.
A new gacha game full of charm and high class characters with a fun and dynamic gameplay. But it's the mix of inspirations that makes up the universe that really catches the eye.

Obviously, if the gachas and the character and equipment obtaining system in the other Hoyoverse titles don't appeal to you, then it certainly won't be Zenless Zone Zero that will change your mind - but, beyond that, this new title is certainly a more than valid action RPG that underlines the great awareness achieved by Hoyoverse, which only moves when it is sure of hitting the mark.

Zenless Zone Zero is style and is substance, a game with hypnotic action not only because of its visual accomplishments, but also because of how addictive is its gameplay. If HoYoverse properly supports it in the future, then this will be the studio's third victory.

critic.quote: The game is a cinematic experience that could make a rock emotional, offering newcomers and seasoned zombifiers alike the chance to experience that jaw-dropping, heart-pounding feeling. [Issue#322]
Unforgettable characters, sky-high stakes, nail-biting action, and impeccable pacing make The Last of Us Part I a superlative gaming experience in every possible sense.

This is the best game for players who want to feel the impression of the original once again with improved graphics. It delivers the nostalgic impression we have all experienced beyond time with outstanding narratives and enhanced facial expressions of the characters. However, the fully priced game despite the same story in 9 years can make you think twice before buying it.

Worthy of being hailed as a potential Game of the Generation when it was first released, The Last of Us Part I is fully remade for a new generation of PlayStation consoles. With some of Naughty Dog's best graphical tech to date, this is one you'll have to see to believe.
An unnecesary remake, perhaps, but a pleasurable one and a good way to discover a masterpiece.

The Last of Us Part 1 is the definitive way to experience the original story and Left Behind. However, it’s hard to recommend it over the PS4 remaster. I appreciate all the work that went into enhancing the visual and audio fidelity and gameplay. However, it’s just not $50 worth of improvement, and the lack of new content means you’re not missing out too much if you decide to go cheaper.

武者笃孤行于世，家仇未雪的她，誓报昔年灭门之恨。她将踏遍虾夷山川，追索仇寇六人。且助她邂逅奇缘，缔结羁绊，寻得救赎，重塑归途。
在幕府辖外的日本北境，纵横于刀锋之间。不止快意厮杀，在羊蹄山麓拼凑出笃不循常轨的命途。此版本内含：
弦续关原•
• 深入体验一段围绕笃过往展开的全新剧情扩展内容，探索虾夷的全新区域，了解更多关原之战的往事，并掌握一种全新武器。
无尽追缉模式•
• 挑战全新战斗生存模式，对抗一波波全新敌人与强力首领，同时解锁新武器、外观和全新可游玩角色。
《羊蹄山之魂》™奇谈模式•
• 与友人在线结伴，共讨妖化异变的羊蹄六人帮。²核心游戏模式包括：生存战模式、剧情模式、攻坚战模式。

■ 购成品
[红色沙漠游戏本体]
[PS5购买特典]
- 格罗特班特板金套装(头盔、盔甲、披风、手套、鞋子)
* 可在游戏内菜单 → 其他 → 设置 → 附加内容中领取奖励。
■ 灰鬃征途再次启程
除了全新剧情与动画，还新增更多配音和翻译。一起来体验更加丰富多彩的红色沙漠吧
红色沙漠自发售以来历经多次更新，包括全新内容、坐骑、宠物及自定义功能，并进行了多项便利性优化，使得整体完成度不断提升。相信数百万玩家的选择，马上开启全新冒险之旅吧！
■ 自由探险未知世界
帕卫尔大陆——旅程的开始
邀请你一同踏入其中。
绵延无尽的葱郁平原与茂密森林、到干旱的沙漠与崎岖的群山
沿着遍布各处、引人好奇的古老遗迹与隐藏的宝藏前行，你终将抵达天空彼端的神秘领域——“阿比斯”。
在那里，一场威胁世界的神秘失衡正等待被修复。
世界由你自由探索，众多道路等待你去发现。
你可以抓住马鬃横穿草原，也可以乘坐巨龙或机器人驰骋大地。
在无数任务、与陌生人的遇见、以及巨大的挑战与战斗等待着你的地方，你的故事将由此展开。
■ 属于我的战斗，属于我的战场
《红色沙漠》残酷的战场从没有标准答案。
如何组合并运用你所拥有的各类技能与装备，取决于你的选择。
获得剑与枪、大剑、斧、双持武器，以及多种远程武器等各式装备，
用强势连招攻击施放强力技能与元素强化能力。
在一次攻击与一次移动都可能改写命运的高强度战斗中，你必须开拓属于自己的路。
从冷酷无情的战士到凶猛的野兽，帕卫尔各处都潜伏着试图将你击倒的人。
从令人手心冒汗的1对1战斗，到小规模混战与大规模战争，迎战各类敌人与BOSS怪，
击倒并战胜一切挡在你面前的威胁。
■ 帕卫尔的一天
在帕卫尔这里，无数细小瞬间汇聚成你的旅程，也塑造着日复一日的生活。
在广阔的帕卫尔大地上探险，采集资源，并通过料理、钓鱼、狩猎等多样活动补充物资，让装备得到更强的锻造与强化。
在旅途中你也可以与当地居民一起游玩各种小游戏，享受片刻的悠闲时光。
别忘了在开始一天之前，按当日心情设置发型与纹身；可以使用在旅途中发现或亲手制作染料，并用它变更服装颜色的自定义功能，同样不可错过。

游戏深度还原了百工百器、建筑营造、历法天象、民俗游艺、岐黄医术等16种文化建树，展现出极具时代氛围和东方魅力的古代社会画卷。
--不是其他开放世界，是沉浸开放历史--
不束缚，真开放
古代风貌，中式绝活，史话趣谈...脚下热土，是叙不尽的历史烟火和真实生活。
纯粹写实的画面品质，只是为了让武侠世界本该如此。
--不是其他武侠网游，是独众皆乐之旅--
不套路，真武侠
见招拆招，单人探索，多人同行…无门无派练就武学奇术，不问出处我即是我。
充满疑局的单人探索体验，将只是广阔侠旅的一个注脚。
--不是其他MMO，是无限未定人生--
不规训，真自由
通关无线路，冒险无目标，人生无定义…...抛却所有既定，才有人人向往的自由。
挣脱过往的规则束缚，聆听心中所想，创造独一无二的游戏之旅。
--不是其他常规战斗，是纯正武术打斗--
不妥协，真动作
着力反馈，攻守博弈，真实打斗…玩转十八般武器，兼具物理科学与暴力美学。
精心设计的武侠动作，兼纳百家的武学理念，出手即是真功夫。
--不是其他江湖市井，是华夏文明之声--
不独响，真共鸣
百工百器，刑罚律令，王道兵戈…聆听电影级文化叙事，探寻看得见的声音。
游览燕云大地，深入中式谜境，和鲜为人知的时代记忆不期而遇。

critic.quote: Delta Force from developer Team Jade is a wonderful free-to-play tactical shooter. It is driven by a massive 64-player online mode featuring gigantic and towering maps, while also containing some reprieve in its Operations mode that is more personal and linear. The game needs a bit more balance in its player selection at the moment, and a controller option, but as of right now it looks to be on t
Delta Force is both a good large-scale PvP shooter and a serviceable extraction shooter, equal parts solid and unremarkable at each.
Delta Force hits the mark as a challenging tactical shooter, but it lacks the original ideas and authenticity to be a real hit.
An entertaining one-stop-shop for competitive multiplayer action, but the recently released Black Hawk Down campaign is an unpleasant war simulation in all the wrong ways.

Where Black Hawk Down bombards you with exasperating shootouts and tedious escort missions set against a background of jingoism, its competitive modes struggle for the refinements of a game made a decade ago. [Issue#409, p.112]

As is always the case with these types of things, install and play Delta Force at your own discretion. For a free-to-play shooter, it’s a solid game, but nothing too special. Worth trying out for the sake of a new shooter, but it probably won't tempt you away if you're happy with your current multiplayer game or if you object to kernel-level anti-cheats. [Review in Progress]

s.desc:
《晶核》是一款魔導龐克題材的合作共鬥動作RPG。遊戲含有魔導龐克元素，多職業自由選擇、探索立體箱庭及多人共鬥等玩法。動作格鬥是核心玩法之一，其獨特的空中戰鬥系統，為玩家帶來更極致的戰鬥體驗。在遊戲中，玩家將作為荊棘鳥冒險者協會的一員開始探索阿特蘭，一步步揭開謎底，讓阿特蘭世界的秩序重歸寧靜。
晶核現世，紛爭開啟；冒險者，你準備好了嗎？
□ 魔法與機械共奏 探索阿特蘭的奧秘
在魔法與機械共奏的浮空世界中，自由的冒險者開始探索遺跡，並發現世界的真相！在探索「古阿特蘭遺跡」的旅程中，冒險者將遇上劣化的怪物、結識各式各樣的伙伴，並一同穿越時光的帷幕，親眼見證最古老的魔法與機械軍團。隨著他們一步步深入未知，塵封的謎底將逐漸被揭曉，最終引領阿特蘭世界重獲秩序與寧靜。
■ 超爽快動作連擊 體驗花式Combo
玩家能盡情享受從地面打到空中的暢快連擊，抓準時機浮空閃避，進而發掘意想不到的驚喜，全方位建構的多維度戰鬥打擊面，在瞬息萬變的戰局中體驗一擊制敵的爽快攻擊感！清晰的受擊反應、碰撞、擊飛動作，結合環境互動與戰鬥音效所帶來的真實物理反饋，粒子碰撞加持，使技能演出更加華麗，放大戰鬥的特效與臨場感。
□ 多種職業自由選 打造你的專屬技能
遊戲開局即可自由選擇多種職業。每個職業皆擁有超過20種技能組合，為玩家提供豐富多元的搭配可能性，鼓勵玩家嘗試不同想法，打造屬於你的專屬技能。
■ 多人團本新體驗 共鬥才是通關奧義
在危險重重、迷霧重重的冒險旅途中，冒險者從不是孤身前行的！你可以與夥伴組成一支兼具實力與勇氣的冒險者團隊，並與志同道合的夥伴建立屬於自己的艦隊，在阿特蘭大陸上與眾多艦隊角逐較量，追尋「最強」之名！

在這裡，戰鬥的勝負回歸操作與技術本身。無論是在 1V1 的排位賽單挑，還是 3V3 的團隊戰，都會維持職業平衡，以確保所有玩家在同一起跑線上展開較量。靈活走位、技能連段與時機掌握，都會成為左右戰局的關鍵。即刻開啟「靠實力說話」的熱血對決，每一場戰鬥都值得認真對待。

透過直覺化的操作設計與清晰的新手引導，讓即使是首次體驗動作遊戲的玩家，也能迅速上手、使出流暢連擊。無需長時間的學習或研究數值，也能立刻感受到戰鬥打擊的爽感，享受動作遊戲的魅力。

《鸣潮》是一款跨平台开放世界动作游戏，主打高自由度的动作战斗玩法与丰富多样的开放世界探索。而你，在这个世界苏醒的漂泊者，将在找回记忆、寻找自我身份的同时结识无数的共鸣者同伴，并和伙伴一起踏上改变这个世界的旅途。
荣获The Game Awards2025玩家之声
The Game Awards2024最佳移动游戏提名
The Game Awards2025最佳移动游戏提名

游戏介绍
漂泊的旅人，欢迎在这里醒来。
涨落无声，我们的世界刚刚经历一场退潮。
悲鸣降临，人类被旧日的法则遗留，文明于滩涂搁浅。
但所有静默之后，是不遗余力的发声。
随毁灭一同出现的异象，同样带来了新生，人类正与它们一起，开创全新纪元。
而你——漂泊者，你的旅途才刚刚开始。
或是邂逅并肩作战的伙伴，对峙无法想象的劲敌，或是吸纳改变自身的力量，揭露颠覆一切的真相，又或者，只是探索未曾目睹的奇观，尽可能延伸你能抵达的边界……我们无从知晓你将做出的选择，但我们期待你在灾厄余音中找到的答案。或许，你就是那个带领人类跨越滩涂的人。
潮声循环往复，文明再度启程。
请踏上，属于你的旅途。
游戏特色
——探索开放世界 / 世界失序 文明启于悲鸣之后
《鸣潮》是一款开放世界游戏，拥有高机动性的探索体验。解放奔跑体力限制、蹬墙跑酷、自由翱翔、驾驶高机动性的科考摩托，享受无拘无束的开放世界探索。作为在索拉里斯的世界苏醒的漂泊者，你将在这个无边开放世界中开启一段找回回忆、寻找自我身份的旅程。
——极致动作体验 / 行云流水 体验高速流畅战斗
作为一款动作游戏，《鸣潮》拥有高速且流畅的战斗体验，在战斗中轻松使用极限闪避、逆势回击、声骸协战、特色的QTE等玩法，让每一场战斗酣畅淋漓。
——沉浸式剧情演出 / 细腻视听 见证每个动人故事
《鸣潮》致力于玩家提供优质的游戏声画体验，通过高品质的剧情、音乐、动画演出，让每一位漂泊者在《鸣潮》的索拉里斯世界中沉浸式体验每一个动人的故事。
——结识共鸣者同伴 / 共鸣觉醒 旅途之中结伴同行
在旅途中，你将结识许多能力各异的共鸣者伙伴，陪伴你一同探索未知的未来。每位共鸣者都有着各自独特的个性与能力，为你的《鸣潮》之旅提供不可或缺的助力。

With its stunning visuals, gripping storytelling, addictive gameplay, and robust multiplayer features, Diablo IV is an absolute must-play for any fan of the action role-playing genre. Prepare to be ensnared by the dark embrace of Diablo IV,
While Activision Blizzard certainly isn't without sin, Diablo IV is a devil well worth dealing with.

Diablo IV has set the golden standard for what a modern Blizzard game should be. It is not only a fantastic Diablo game but gives us a glimpse that the once-beloved publisher still has that magic that it was most well-known for in years past.
The rush of defeating hordes of enemies for increasingly incredible weapons and armor simply can't be beat.

The first version of Diablo 4 is a canvas on which the developers could, over the months, paint a true masterpiece. The equipment and progression system is extremely robust and lends itself well to the significant innovations that the team plans to implement in the production lifecycle, through patches and expansions. If Blizzard manages to keep the attention high on the title and make the right c

Theory-crafters, lore hounds and newcomers can all find something to love about Diablo 4 — as long as their interests converge on beating demons to death. Gruesomely satisfying combat, expansive skill trees and a bustling open world make Diablo 4 a delightfully gory way to kick off summer, and a must-play for ARPG fans.

critic.quote: The Ground Forces expansion makes War Thunder even bigger than it was already, an MMO F2P that lets you choose the war you want: simulation or arcade, air or ground, challenging or relaxing, competitive or cooperative, free or with fee, PC or PS4.

War Thunder surprised me. I am not very good at it, but I still have a lot of fun playing it. Because it is a free-to-play game, some players will download it on a whim and quit 20 minutes in due to the poor controls. Those that brave the steep learning curve will be rewarded with a realistic combat simulator that could be truly great one day.

War Thunder is easily among the best of what is offered on the PlayStation Store. It stands head and shoulders above the other free to play offerings and even over many at cost. The core of this lies in the generous free to play model which allows you to play for hour and hours without paying a dime. Though microtransactions were disabled in the pre-release version, I did get to explore the store
War Thunder delivers a deep, engaging experience, packed with plenty of missions and planes to unlock.

War Thunder has some issues here and there, but it’s a very competent flying and ground war game that doesn’t let its microtransaction component get in the way. There’s plenty of tanks and planes to try out and modify to your liking, and just enough visuals to enjoy along the way. It’s not perfect, but it’s a solid game.
Easy to get into, difficult to master, and free as a bird. Definitely sample-worthy. [February 2014, p79]

s.desc:
无数生灵繁衍聚集的广袤大陆「提瓦特」，天地万象蕴含其间。
这里是七神统治、七种元素交汇的世界……
陌生的天空下，少年少女立于尘沙。
你们是一对旅行中的双子，从世界之外漂流而来。你的血亲被陌生的神灵带走，而你也被神封印，陷入沉眠。
再度醒来，天地间风景已变……
《原神》是一款全新开放世界冒险RPG。你将在游戏中探索一个被称作「提瓦特」的幻想世界。
在这广阔的世界中，你可以踏遍七国，邂逅性格各异、能力独特的同伴，与他们一同对抗强敌，踏上寻回血亲之路；也可以不带目的地漫游，沉浸在充满生机的世界里，让好奇心驱使自己发掘各个角落的奥秘……
直到你与分离的血亲重聚，在终点见证一切事物的沉淀。
〓开放世界，自由探索〓
《原神》是一款开放世界冒险游戏，这意味着从你踏入「提瓦特」的第一刻起，只要合理规划自己的体力，不论翻山越岭、还是横渡江河，总有办法见到新的风景。若见到游荡的仙灵、奇异的装置，不妨上前探究一番，看看迎接你的是意外，还是惊喜？
〓元素交互，策略战斗〓
在这片元素交汇的土地上，世界由风、雷、水、火、冰、草、岩七大元素构成，拥有「神之眼」的角色能引导元素之力用于战斗和探险。水与火相遇触发「蒸发」，火与雷引起「超载」，雷遇水附加「感电」……针对不同敌人，使用技能触发适当的元素效果，是制胜的关键。
〓美术音乐，品质呈现〓
《原神》美术风格清新通透，过场动画实时渲染，角色动作经由动捕与细致调整而来，呈现出高品质演出效果。随着24小时昼夜更替，天气与音乐也在动态变化，无论身处何地，总能聆听到由伦敦爱乐乐团、上海交响乐团等世界顶级交响乐团献上的具有地域特色的演奏。
〓众多伙伴，携手冒险〓
在冒险的旅途中，还可结识能力独特的伙伴，不妨摸索最佳队伍搭配、用旅途中搜集的材料强化角色，最终大陆上的魔物与秘境都将被你征服。立于绝云之巅，阴晴雨雪、云卷云舒似乎尽在眼前。但失散的血亲尚未重聚，「原神」的真相仍未显现……动身吧，旅行者，真正的冒险才刚刚开始呢。
〓悠游千星，共筑奇域〓
游玩「千星奇域」，这是一个由旅行者主导的，集游玩、社交、构筑于一体的梦幻乐园。你将获得两位「奇域人偶」，自由搭配服饰定制穿搭。走进「奇域大厅」邂逅各种朋友，选择「奇域关卡」挑战各类冒险……还可以成为「奇匠」发挥无限想象，利用「千星沙箱」打造独一无二的玩法。
本游戏内含自愿使用虚拟货币进行的游戏内购，虚拟货币可用于获取各种随机的游戏内虚拟物品。

critic.quote: Elden Ring is simply a game that the player naturally adapts to their own style of play. Challenging at times, vicious at others, but mostly incredibly fun. The enjoyable pace makes the hours of play pass by like water, and each path opens up a few more, only to come together again after a fair amount of exploration before the next big reveal. [Issue#318]

Elden Ring is a superlative title, one of those works capable of becoming an event and becoming engraved in the collective imagination. It achieves this by remaining faithful to its formula and exporting its identity to the concept of the open world, achieving its own personal approach, resulting in a world that is visually stunning, and that works with overwhelming precision in terms of mechanics

Elden Ring packs its intricately crafted world - a world which should be used as a reference point for open-world design moving forward - with more impressive boss fights and secrets than you can shake a giant greatsword at. Although its punishing combat system may not be to everyone’s taste, it is an essential experience both for FromSoftware newcomers and seasoned veterans alike.

Elden Ring is a crowning achievement of over a decade of Miyazaki’s and FromSoftware’s work, and an amazing example of how to find a whole new level of fun in a well-known and somewhat worn-out formula. The open world turned out to be a perfect fit for the genre and you can still tell this masterpiece was created by the famous Japanese studio. I honestly haven’t been so excited about a game since

Elden Ring feels like the natural evolution of a video game series that continues to reinvent itself after more than 13 years of its birth. FromSoftware is simply the best at what they do. While there are some technical issues and repetitive structures and creatures, Elden Ring is a cruelly wonderful piece of work and one of the best adventure games of recent years.
The years of waiting were worth it, Elden Ring is brilliant. It offers a huge amount of content, a beautiful world and addictive gameplay. But the series does start to feel a little bit stale.

s.desc:
立即预购《Forza Horizon 6》，即可在游戏内获得一辆专属预调法拉利 J50！
驾驶超过 550 辆真实存在的车辆，探索日本的绝美风光，在《极限竞速：地平线》系列史上规模最大的开放世界驾驶冒险中书写属于你的赛车传奇。
你的地平线传奇之旅即刻开始——日本的大好山河等待你的探索！
体验《极限竞速：地平线》最大的游戏世界——东京
欢迎来到东京！在这里，乡村与城市景观有机融合，伴你在地平线有史以来密度最高的地图中探索隐藏秘密，体验精密的纵向设计，游览设计丰富的生态环境，享受绝佳驾驶体验。漫游东京，在郊区和极具标志性的市区街道尽情兜风，在码头与工业区挑战自己的驾驶技术，饱览《极限竞速：地平线》系列史上最大的城市区域风光，尽情畅游这座车迷家园。
沉浸式体验日本浓厚的汽车文化
驾驶超过 550 辆真实存在的车辆——其中不乏人气超高、粉丝热捧的 JDM 经典车型。车辆配备精致引擎声浪与全面更新的转向动画，更有高达 540 度的轮胎旋转图形。探索日本的过程中，你还有机会收集带有极限改装的极限竞速特别版车辆、寻获可供试驾和购买的稀有改装车辆。你将在名利双收的赛车之旅中遇到各位地平线嘉年华传奇、参与峠道赛，体验根植于日本传奇汽车文化、原汁原味的精彩故事。
在日本尽情探索、疯狂竞速
在《极限竞速：地平线 6》中，你将探索各种丰富的故事内容，探索日本各地，参与嘉年华竞速赛事，单独畅玩或与好友一起合作游戏。*你将作为游客踏上日本的土地，以一届新人车手的身份，证明自己拥有在地平线嘉年华大放异彩的实力。与此同时，你还能探索日本各地、完成自己的收集簿。在地平线邀请赛中获得嘉年华的参与资格、一路提升等级、获得性能逐步攀升的车辆、不断升级腕带，最终成为地平线传奇。获得这一头衔后，你还将登陆传奇岛，踏上只有顶尖车手才才有资格登上的舞台。
广阔世界任你改造
旅程中，你还可以在日本各地购买各式房屋，每一座都具有可定制车库，可供你尽情翻新，打造展示自己车辆收藏的理想空间。你也可以选择在线下载玩家社群分享的布局设计。解锁山谷地产，在开放世界中发挥创意，随心建造。也别忘了你最爱的汽车们，可以选用全新的极限竞速空气动力学选项与车身套件进行改装——还可以在车窗上使用自定义涂装哦！
与玩家社群一起进行多人游戏
嘉年华，当然要和好友一起才有滋味。*无缝加入计时赛和直线加速赛，在车友会中炫耀你的定制座驾。与其他玩家一起获得全新的合作 LINK 技术，参与规格锦标赛，或者直接加入大家熟悉的地平线多人游戏模式，参与精彩刺激的淘汰之王、捉迷藏等活动！
随时随地，共享设计乐趣

众人同乐的嘉年华

s.desc:
人气动物园模拟游戏续作《动物园之星 2》来袭，邀你打造野趣盎然的世界。放飞创意，建造环球特色动物园，守护自然生灵百态。系列首次收录水生、飞行物种，动物阵容全面升级。践行自然保育使命，将动物放归至广袤无垠、支持自由规划的野生动物保护区。
震撼生灵
动物阵容丰富多彩，需求习性各具特色。众多全新物种，与西非狮、西非黑猩猩等老牌明星一同入驻。以极致写实的细腻质感，打造极具代表性的动物园生态谱系。
搭建优美宜居的栖地，让动物自在生长、随性融入自然生态，或是依循天性结伴活动，或是悠然啃食你栽种的植被。动物细节与沉浸感迎来世代级跃升，动作流畅逼真，情绪生动传神，赋予每只动物前所未有的鲜活灵魂。
奇幻水族
备好潜水装备！纯水生物种首度亮相，掀起全新生态浪潮！随心规划壮观的淡水、海水水族箱，让千姿百态的游水生灵，自在徜徉。水下世界，别开生面，缤纷鱼群、乌翅真鲨、玳瑁……万千灵动，在此汇聚！
灵动飞羽
直上云霄，邂逅多样的美丽飞鸟，将巨嘴鸟的绚烂、蛇鹫的气度尽收眼底。用围栏、立柱与动态网罩，自由搭建可全方位定制的鸟舍，给鸟儿一片安全无拘的翱翔天地。静静观赏鸟儿在地面栖落、于长空遨游，在专属栖地中展现灵活百态。
野生动物保护区
动物保育，从此突破园区边界！投身全球保育项目，完成特定要求，便可将动物放归至全球各地的超大自定义野生动物保护区，亲手缔造生生不息的自然生态圈。
让创意，展翅高飞
横跨全球多种生物群系，建造梦想中的动物园。四种全新景物主题，撷取世界标志性建筑风貌；五种初代《动物园之星》主题，也将悉数回归。海量景物组件，为你铺开无限创作可能。
你可以轻松套用现成蓝图，省心省力；也可使用系列经典逐件拼装建造工具，从零开始挥洒创意，把心中构想化为现实。
缩放调节、随心配色、便捷道路铺设系统一应俱全，搭配全新植被与地形笔刷，精调每一处细节，让动物园与野生动物保护区焕然一新。
科学守护，意义非凡
精心搭建宜居栖地，吸引客流，提升动物园评分，赚取资金，助力动物园持续扩建与发展。
统筹动物园日常运营，为游客打造沉浸式游览空间，将动物科普融入每一处角落。配置各式商铺与便利设施，全方位满足游客需求，为他们打造惬意圆满的游园之旅。
野性天地，正待开启
在生涯模式中，加入 FEN（Fauna and Ecosystems Network，动物与生态系统网络），走遍全球，开启趣味满满的保育冒险。在品牌事业模式中，建立覆盖全球的动物园与野生动物保护区网络，与其他玩家进行动物交易；或在沙盒模式中，拥抱无拘无束的创造乐趣。
同心同行，共护自然
前往 Frontier Workshop，探索海量玩家社群创作内容。浏览下载各式跨平台玩家蓝图与原创作品，订阅心仪佳作，便可轻松置入自己的动物园中。

critic.quote: Planet Zoo 2 raises the bar for the simulation genre, with new features and quality-of-life tweaks making the latest Frontier Developments title not only as the kings of the jungle, but also conquerors of the sea and the air.
The fantastic aquariums and aviaries make Planet Zoo 2 the ultimate zoo simulator, though quite a few animals from multiple continents are still needed to make that dream complete.
Planet Zoo 2 isn’t a revolution, but it doesn’t need to be. It takes what made the original great and improves upon it in every way.

There’s a lot to appreciate about Planet Zoo 2, from better-looking animals that behave more realistically, to new biomes and building tools. Some improvements in existing systems, a few borrowed from other Frontier games, are also welcome. Just like with Planet Coaster 2, dedicated players will need to rebuy content that they can no longer use, and hope a particular species they loved will return
Quotation forthcoming.

For anyone who loves animals, that's a strong selling point. The appeal of a zoo isn't the satisfaction of building an efficient attraction. For me, it's when you see a creature doing something charming and realize you've forgotten, for a little while, that you're supposed to be in charge. Sometimes, the best zoo manager is the one who knows when to put the math problems away and watch the otters.

Forget about other zoo management games, this could well be the best simulation game ever made. A magnificent masterpiece.

critic.quote: Gran Turismo 7 is a game with an exquisite and addictive experience thanks to the support of DualSense and Tempest 3D Audio Tech. Following Gran Turismo Sport's disappointment, Polyphony regained his throne.

Gran Turismo 7 brings to the tracks every single thing fans always wanted: the GT Mode everyone loves, plenty of customization options, car loads, classic scenarios and one of the best DualSense and 3D Audio experiences the PS5 has to offer. This is the best Gran Turismo experience we have ever seen in a long time.

Polyphony Digital comes back to the roots with a driving simulator that feels better than ever by doing the same as ever, thanks to a very unique style. It has some little issues in terms of balance, but, inside the tracks and beyond them, it is a worthy successor of 25 years of Gran Turismo legacy.
Gran Turismo 7 is the definitive driving experience of this generation, but may be a lot to take in for the casual player.

s.desc:
BeamNG.drive 是一款非常逼真的模拟驾驶游戏，拥有近乎无限的可能。我们的软体物理引擎可以实时模拟车辆的各个部件，达到与现实相同的效果。经过多年的精心设计、深入研究与丰富体验，BeamNG.drive 真实地还原了在现实世界中驾驶车辆的乐趣。
为什么 BeamNG.drive 是最适合您的游戏?
软体物理系统：BeamNG 的物理引擎是整个游戏的核心，能够为您带来原汁原味、前所未有的车辆模拟体验。游戏使用了非常精准的损伤模型，车辆碰撞的感觉无比真实。
车辆： BeamNG.drive 提供了几十种完全可自定义的精致车辆。无论是小型车辆还是大型卡车，您都可以调整所有的可操控部件，打造您梦想中的驾驶体验。车轮、悬挂、引擎等等... 一切尽在您的掌控之中。
环境： 驾驶途中您将会有许多奇妙的发现。12+ 个广阔无垠、景色秀丽的开放世界等您探索，复杂的地形与游戏设置一样变化多样。您可以在热带丛林小径、荒芜沙漠、城市大道和拥挤的高速公路等各种地方中测试您调试好的新车。
更多内容
游戏模式： 这款游戏不仅能给您带来普通的驾驶模拟体验。游戏内还有各种异彩纷呈的玩法选项，您既可以完成简单的运送任务，也可以创建一个完整的地图，以用来测试您新打造的座驾。
- 畅行模式：不喜欢受到限制的感觉？选择一辆爱车，前往任意目的地，开始自由探索。在这个游戏模式中，实验也是一大重点内容，您可以自由操控物体与实验环境。例如，您可以尝试提高风速以增加一点挑战性，或是改变重力！
- 情景： BeamNG.drive 为各位喜欢驾驶车辆的玩家提供了多种不同的情景。您可以追求速度与效率，完成卡车运送货物的任务，或是与警车展开一场紧张刺激的角逐。无论在哪种情景下，逼真的物理引擎都能够让您全身心地沉浸其中。
- 计时赛：选择一款车辆、环境与路线，检验您的驾驶技巧！磨炼您的技术，不断挑战自己，刷新最佳时间记录。
自由度： BeamNG.drive 与其他汽车游戏不同的地方就在于，它给予了玩家很高的自由度。在这款游戏中，您可以用汽车或卡车做几乎任何您能想到的事情，并以最接近现实的方式看到事情的结果。您可以使用我们的软体物理引擎和自定义功能，制作出几乎任何想要的场景。这款游戏不仅能为您提供丰富的车辆，您还能利用可自定义的广阔开放世界打造自己梦想中的驾驶体验。业界领先的物理系统、无限可能的自定义内容与紧密团结的社区，BeamNG.drive 一定是您游玩过的最细致完整、最妙趣横生的车辆模拟游戏。
抢先体验：BeamNG.drive 即将在 PlayStation 平台推出抢先体验版。这代表游戏仍在积极开发中，玩家可以在开发团队持续改进和扩展游戏体验的过程中，亲身见证其演变过程。在抢先体验期间购买游戏的玩家，既能抢先探索逼真的物理引擎、各种车辆和玩法，还能通过提供反馈帮助塑造游戏未来的开发方向。

critic.quote: Between the at-odds-with-itself career mode and the horrible controller implementation, this is one of those ports that is so poorly executed, it will take a long time for me to go back and take a look at the original release of BeamNG.drive.

s.desc:
鬼武者系列完全新作！
本作是刀光血影、以牙还牙的极致动作游戏。
这次的舞台设在日本江户时代初期的“京都”，
历史悠久的都城因瘴气而面目全非。
形形色色的关卡无一不充满了诡异气息。
来自异界的恐怖“幻魔”，和苟延残喘的人们，共同交织出一幕幕黑暗的奇幻故事。
而在这京都之内，一位佩戴“鬼之笼手”的武士正四处奔波，斩杀猖獗肆虐的幻魔。
在激烈的刀光剑影之中沐浴鲜血，不断寻求战斗的意义。
前行的道路，终将通往何处？
本作品的主角──宫本武藏。
血气方刚的武者，为在剑道上登峰造极而现身京都。
但其修行之路，恐会无比曲折离奇。
Capcom在塑造“宫本武藏”时，为了使这位武士的形象更加深入人心，
参考了世界知名的武士演员——三船敏郎，作为角色形象。
本作所描绘的主角年盛气强，是一位在腥风血雨中奋战，在泥泞中前行的武士。
动作
宫本武葳获得的鬼之笼手拥有着异于常人的力量。
笼手除了能够讨伐幻魔，还能吸收敌人释放出的灵魂，根据灵魂种类可获得不同的效果。
从笼手中传来一把声音，究竟是谁？
幻魔
本盘踞在地狱深处的残暴怪物，如今却现形于瘴气弥漫的京都之中。
幻魔残虐不仁，穷凶极恶，让整个京都人心惶惶。
强敌
接连向武藏发动攻势的各路强敌。
其实力无比高强，绝非那些在街头巷尾撒野的一般幻魔所能比拟。
杀，抑或是被杀——
刀光血影、以牙还牙的死斗，将在京都这个舞台上不断上演。
舞台
本作的舞台是以清水寺为首，神社和佛寺林立的京都。
受瘴气的侵蚀而变得诡异和不可思议。
在使用本游戏软件程序前，请务必阅读并同意以下最终用户使用许可合同的全文。
(https://manual.capcom.com/eula/game/)

critic.quote: Onimusha: Way of the Sword isn't just an excellent series revival from a company that has seemingly mastered them, taking a proper understanding of the early entries' appeal and matching it perfectly to modern sensibilities. It's also just plainly the best action game this year, and probably for the past few years.

Onimusha's return was significant in its own right. But the real value of Way of the Sword lies in the fact that it doesn't simply bring the Onimusha name back. Capcom understood what made the series so beloved and has blended those qualities with the evolution of modern action game design.

This triumphant revival delivers a deep, rewarding combat system and a stunning cinematic presentation despite a sluggish start. While the Kyoto hub feels slightly padded and sub-bosses are occasionally recycled, the breathtaking RE Engine visuals and exhilarating boss encounters ensure a top-tier experience. It successfully modernizes the classic formula without losing its identity to the soulsli

Capcom forges a new katana with Onimusha: Way of the Sword, successfully reinventing the samurai saga for modern times. There is room for improvement, but if this marks the beginning of a second life for the Oni warriors—and we hope it does—it is a great first step along the path of the samurai.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword is a spectacular, challenging samurai action game that will put your reflexes to the test in a ruthless way. It isn’t a ‘soulslike’, but it draws on some of its principles to create electrifying combat.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword successfully revives the series with rewarding swordplay, cinematic combat, and a compelling new protagonist. Uneven pacing, audio problems, awkward movement, and limited accessibility options keep this promising new beginning from reaching its full potential.

s.desc:
《异环》是Hotta Studio自主研发的超自然都市开放世界RPG。故事将从海特洛市启篇，作为首位「无证上岗」的「异象猎人」，你将成为接取民间异象委托维持周转的古董店「伊波恩」的一员，与个性迥异、能力非凡的伙伴们一起探索各城市的大小谜团，历经有笑有泪的各式奇遇，演绎独属于你们的都市物语。
【怪奇都市，异能冒险】
欢迎来到鉴别生涯第一站——生机勃勃、自由开放的海特洛市！
「异象管理局」大厅排队申领居民许可证的「歧骸」们面露憧憬，电车站台前一个响指清洁好自己通勤套装的「异能者」上班族行色匆匆。街这边正上演着鸡飞狗跳的抓捕「团三郎」的好戏，而另一头，巷尾休假的银边手套「管家」可能正与二手电器店的老板亲切攀谈……举目满是「异常」有趣的画面！
想要更了解这个人类与超自然存在密不可分的世界？那就从海特洛市开始切身见证、感受、记录！活泼搞怪的日常生活亦是波澜壮阔的冒险。
【妙趣正片，轻松串联】
今日头条：传闻中只有每月月中夜晚才会现身的神秘当铺？你又能为自己的愿望留下怎样的抵押？
号外号外：塔吉多恋情大危机！浪漫与冲动，心碎与错过！暗恋的塔可小姐即将随担保人搬离海特洛市，在那之前，纯情海獭该如何将自己的心意传递？！
可靠小道消息：照相馆「菲林轨迹」现已恢复营业！「伊波恩」古董店的全员特享专属折扣！
插播一条天气快讯：异象「雨人」进入活跃期，请务必携带雨具出行~
——今日的「10AM」就为你播报到这里。
另有频频交手的神秘异象，牢不可破的「誓约」伟力，「环」这一庞然大物的身影也在支离现世的「预言」回响中愈加清晰……
更多内容，还请由你亲自出演——这些独属于你的剧集篇章。
【同频邂逅，羁遇结伴】
冷清小巷里的神秘店铺，深藏不露的神秘店长，武力值超高的冷酷保镖，「万能机器人」式管家，总跟麻烦事脱不了干系的闯祸精们，还有进食方式成谜的电视机头歧骸维修师！
——身为「伊波恩」一员的欢腾冒险，向来都有精力无限的同伴的陪伴！
人际版图，从热闹的「半角街」开始拓展！勇敢结识更多登场的势力成员，随心增添你的「呗果」好友吧！
从街头店铺的和睦邻里到各有特色的猎人组织，更多奇闻轶事，只待「番外」为你娓娓道来，等你呼朋引伴，四方结缘！
【衣食住行，自由装点】
在你的都市自由探索，选择你熟悉的生活方式，又或大胆尝试些新花样吧！
自由改装你的爱车，在熙熙攘攘的街道上尽情驰骋，感受城市的脉动，又或是乘坐「幽灵号」在异象空间内自由穿行，「嗖」的一声，立抵目的地。
闲暇时刻，是先去「半角街」的老字号店铺逛逛，挑挑秘制的时令新品，还是购置自己的温馨小窝，更换你喜欢的装修风格？
倾听内心的声音、遵循自己的步调去感受吧，被你的信任拥抱的都市，终将回馈你以缤纷多彩、值得纪念的每一天。

critic.quote: NTE is a game that feels like it’s constantly pulling you in different directions, yet somehow still holds together as a cohesive experience. It wants to be a gacha RPG, a city life simulator, a driving game, a management sandbox, and a narrative-driven anomaly hunter all at once. And instead of collapsing under that weight, it actually becomes a strong foundation to support how its systems intera

If you like urban open worlds with life sim elements, then it’s impossible not to recommend NTE right now. This game has one of the most beautiful, vibrant sandbox settings I’ve seen in some time – and despite some irksome characters, I’m generally enjoying its plot so far, which blends slice of life mangas with sci-fi horror. The gacha business model is understandably not going to resonate with e

Neverness to Everness is an ambitious open-world gacha game overflowing with content, whose greatest strength lies in the city of Hethereau and the wide variety of activities it offers, ranging from exploration and management to combat. The gacha system is surprisingly generous compared to the standards of the genre and helps make the experience accessible even to free-to-play users, while the san

It’s a game that requires a lot of improvements before it can be truly great. I think that if you have the teeniest bit of curiosity, there’s nothing that should stop you from trying the game out for yourself. As a gacha game, its monetization isn’t aggressive, and playing it myself throughout this month was an experience I found decent, although it barely hits the passable bar. I’ll be closely fo

The audio department is less impressive, featuring music that serves a functional role within the gameplay—with a few tracks that actually manage to stand out—while the sound effects and voice acting (which we sampled in both English and Japanese) do little to push beyond the typical limitations of the genre, offering many stereotypical performances.

NTE: Neverness to Everness delivers a stylish and surprisingly varied gacha experience, packed with activities and strong presentation. While none of its systems truly stand out, the mix of vibes and accessible progression make it easy to sink hours into. The real test will be its long-term support, but for now, NTE has all the ingredients to become a lasting hit.

critic.quote: So prepare your wands, put on your wizard robe and start exploring this incredibly magical world of Hogwarts which is an amazing homage to Harry Potter universe which set the bar so high, that not even Levioso could put other games on the same level.

As we near the end of this review, I have a small secret. I'm not someone you'd call a "fan" of the Wizarding World, at least not in the sense where I've got my own wand or want to down a butterbeer. I enjoy and appreciate the world that was built and the characters in it, but it's not like I got fully sucked in. That changed a little after a few dozen hours of playing Hogwarts Legacy. If you're a

Hogwarts Legacy is the game Harry Potter fans have dreamt of since the first book was released. It puts you firmly in the shoes of a student and turns you loose to find your place in the world of wizardry. Unfortunately, its biggest issue is that it often feels like you’re just visiting.

Hogwarts Legacy is an experience of mammoth proportions, really difficult to summarize in a few words. A meticulous reproduction of Hogwarts, its intricate labyrinths, its infinite secrets, is accompanied by a rich and multifaceted game structure, which will make you feel like real Hogwarts students for the first time. The game is to all intents and purposes what a Harry Potter fan has always drea

Whether you’re a diehard Potterhead or casual Wizarding World lover, you’ll have an epic time no matter what level of fan you are. Even though there is optional padding, it’s optional nonetheless. The core experience of Hogwarts Legacy is still not only the best game in the entire franchise but a seriously fun RPG that will take your breath away in its pinnacle moments.

The chips might have been stacked against them, but Warner Bros. and Avalanche Software have delivered on their promise. Hogwarts Legacy is the game that fans have been waiting for, laying down a solid foundation to build off of moving forward.

令人屏息的视觉效果

《伊莫》是一款多人在线大世界捉宠RPG。你将在广袤的艾德尔大陆上邂逅各种神奇生物——伊莫。和他们联结合体，还能以全新的视角和能力感受这个世界的美好。你也可以来到浮空天际的近未来都市，邂逅其他冒险家，交流旅途心得或是感受竞技的魅力。快带上你的伊莫，开启一场超越想象的大世界冒险之旅吧！
这莫变！联结变身冒险，探索世界奇妙
在冒险的旅途中，你将与伊莫联结合体，并利用伊莫的各种能力：完成世界上的谜题，赢得每场战斗的胜利，解决遇到的一切问题！不再局限于人类的速度、视野和能力，亲自体验理性与野性共存的蓬勃。与伊莫“联结”合体，用全新的视角感受世界！
这莫多！形态分支进化，填满你的图鉴！
每只伊莫都会因区域、天气、养成方式和成长线的不同，进化出多样分支形态。从沙滩形态到潮湿形态，从晒日光浴的海湾红，到分支进化为女巫草或“家里蹲”埋埋，生态千差万别。丰富的形态图鉴等待你捕捉收集、培养与研究，构筑独属于你的莫百科！
这莫灵！材质表情动作，生动触手可及
或是蓬松的绒毛，或是坚硬的铠甲……逼真的材质、丰富的动作表现，让你穿透屏幕，抚摸生命的灵动。羞羞獭抱铲猛冲、焚火狼静坐火旁、花芽蟹明明强壮却胆小。不经意间展现的小动作和反差正是他们迷人又可爱的地方！当它们敲敲屏幕，那是向你撒娇的信号！
这莫妙！聆听族群故事，细数伊情冷暖
各种神奇生物——伊莫，在艾德尔大陆上共生共舞，每一个种族都各自延续着独特的种族生态与群落故事。每一个角落，都是自然精妙的构思；每一道声音，都记录着生命的回响。更多新的故事会在挥爪一刻与大家邂逅，让每次冒险都更具世界厚度！
这莫爽！即时战斗捕捉，抢蛋其乐无穷
体验真正的即时制自由捉宠战斗的爽快！背袭、连续投掷、出其不意...当捕捉的方式不再单一，每一次丢出谜立方的瞬间都充满了惊喜；全新“抢蛋大作战”加入偷蛋玩法，和朋友一起获得稀有宠物，与其他玩家争夺稀有伊莫蛋，在策略、博弈与运气间享受紧张爽快的对抗！
这莫暖！房车家园旅行，总有伊莫相伴
每位冒险者都有一辆可停驻大世界营地的房车，与其他玩家相遇、交流。当回到家园，可与伊莫一同种植、建造与自由布置空间。旋转木马磨坊、摩天轮纺车等装置将生产与游玩融合，与好友协力和伊莫助力，让家园成为轻松、有趣、充满互动的温暖乐园！

critic.quote: Aniimo is the next big thing. From the incredible creature designs to a world filled with life and magic, there’s just so much to enjoy. There’s a little something for everyone here, although sharing that with people can be a bit cumbersome. Aside from the usual mobile game problems and some UI issues, the game is a great experience. The monetization isn’t too bad, and there’s no gacha for the Ani

The open world stands out for bringing the distinct personalities and ecology of over 200 Aniimo to life. Capturing, Twine, and elemental interactions naturally tie collection and exploration together, though the simplistic combat and lack of polish leave something to be desired. Even so, the game remains highly accessible.

At least for the moment, Aniimo cannot even remotely be considered a "Pokémon killer," as it lacks the fundamental elements needed to truly challenge the GameFreak series—most notably the complete absence of a competitive mode worthy of the name. That said, the adventure crafted by Pawprint Studios is a joy to play and will keep you glued to the screen for hours as you hunt for every creature and

Aniimo is a charmingly detailed live service game with a creature collection system, which is simple on the surface and as deep as the player wants to dive into it. With a focus on exploration, collection and housing, players who want a challenging creature battler may find it lacking, but for everyone who enjoys exploring pastel-coloured worlds along fluffy creatures, Aniimo is worth a look.

Aniimo is a fun free-to-play creature collector with engaging real-time combat and quite a bit of content to explore. The creature design is fantastic, and the world is a beautiful space to explore. The story isn’t earth-shattering, but it keeps things moving along. Aniimo offers a compelling creature-collection experience, successfully capturing the essence of its inspirations while introducing innovative mechanics like regional variants and divergent evolutions. critic.quote: Indeed, Tales of Arise is a game designed for long-term Tales franchise fans and those who have never picked up a franchise entry before, where story, combat, and various features come together to deliver a high-quality, highly-detailed JRPG. All of that makes it not just one of the best JRPGs on the market today, but one of the best games hands-down.

Tales of Arise is a successfully comeback story. It’s definitely one of the most refreshing Tales game and probably one of the best JRPGs launched in 2021. I’m not sure if Bandai Namco planned to make the Tales franchise mainstream, but that’s something that Tales of Arise manage to achieve, and that’s probably the best compliment I can give the game. My only concern is related to how Bandai Namco

Tales of Arise went above and beyond our expectations. With its picturesque landscapes instilling a real sense of adventure, it's easily one of the strongest, most cohesive Tales games to date. Dramatic cutscenes and memorable character moments help sell an intriguing story, while a satisfying combat system becomes more and more engaging as your party powers up. A fantastic, modernised journey wit
Tales of Arise is a great game and a significant step forward from its predecessor, a wonderful mix of bright narrative and excellent gameplay.

Bandai Namco created something special here. Fast-paced, accessible combat meets a well-constructed narrative told with beautiful visuals, wonderful voice work, and an impeccable soundtrack. Even with its odd issue here and there, nothing stands in the way of Tales of Arise succeeding on all levels.

Tales of Arise is a triumph in almost every way, delivering a strong narrative, well-developed characters, and combat that feels snappier than ever. This is the next step in the evolution of the Tales series, and the future looks awfully bright.

在《四海兄弟：故乡》中揭开有组织犯罪的起源，切身体验一段设定于1900年代西西里岛残酷的帮派故事。在这个以危险、无情的时代为背景的沉浸式第三人称动作冒险游戏中，化身恩佐·法瓦拉，为生存而战，向家族证明你的价值。
为了生存恩佐愿意做任何事。经历了饱受强迫劳动折磨的残酷童年之后，他决意孤注一掷，在托里西家族中成为一名荣誉之人。
他对黑手党立下的誓言，连同随之而来的所有权力、诱惑与艰辛，有力地提醒着人们一个简单的事实：
家族荣耀来自牺牲。
令人惊叹的视觉效果、电影般的叙事方式以及《四海兄弟》系列广为人知且备受赞誉的极致真实感，将这部惊心动魄的叙事巨作栩栩如生地呈现在观众面前。恩佐的故事发生在这样一个时代：熟练挥舞弹簧刀的技能是一种致命又宝贵的财富；卢帕拉削短型霰弹枪是出门必备的枪械；夺命的宿仇持续几十年之久；黑手党成员或步行、骑马，或开着世纪之交发明的汽车巡逻，收取保护费。

critic.quote: Mafia: The Old Country doesn't reinvent the wheel, but it does take players to a beautiful new locale for a full-fledged Mafia game like any other - and possibly the best one yet. The Old Country makes for a sublime addition to the series.

A tight and memorable tale chock full of high-quality writing, charismatic characters and exciting story twists. Mafia: The Old Country may not break new ground on the gameplay front, but it succeeds in being one of the best interactive movies I have ever played.
Mafia: The Old Country is a conventional but effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia II, and it boasts a wonderful eye and ear for detail.

Mafia: The Old Country doesn’t stand out for its campaign length, which could have been a bit longer. Still, in its 12-hour runtime, it offers a solid story and charismatic characters that will please fans of mafia-themed stories, even if the plot itself isn't particularly surprising.

If you can forgive those insecurities, perhaps the result of trying to balance a mainstream genre game with more experimental narrative ambitions, The Old Country has an enormous amount of heart. [Issue#415, p.88]

Mafia The Old Country paints an evocative 1902 Sicily with stellar art direction, strong performances, and competent cover shooting. Frequent performance drops, constrained mission design despite a broad map, dated stealth, and repetitive knife encounters erode the momentum, and a finale that fails to deliver undercuts the narrative. A beautiful, ambitious entry that too often frustrates, worth it

critic.quote: Stakes and tensions run high whether playing solo or in a group, but the game truly shines when you’re working with a coherent team, so pick this game up and find one.

There's a lot of depth and strategy to be found in Rainbow Six: Siege, especially when you're playing with a headset. However, the lack of content is something to be considered when pondering the game's retail price.
An FPS where your weapon should be the last thing you use, not the first, Rainbow Six Siege is a fantastic tactical shooter.

The gameplay is solid as a rock; super intense, exciting and porn for the tactical shooter fan. But the game quickly loses its power when you stray among the other game modes, which are limited and lacking good AI. This is what they call: too little content for too much money. [Dec. 2015, p.054]
Siege is both unforgivably callow and inarguably satisfying. Like parades or fireworks, it’s a vision that’s only fun if you can forget where it comes from and where it points to.

Siege can feel cool and inhospitable, but when the conditions are right and you're playing with friends, the game's tense gameplay and measured pacing makes for a refreshing, cerebral contrast to the run-and-gun hyperactivity of most online shooters. [Feb 2016, p.104]

s.desc:
各种凶狠、恐怖的魔怪遍布于路易斯安那的沼泽地，而您身为老练赏金猎人团的其中一员，受雇消灭这些骇人的鬼怪，让他们永远从这个世界上消失。只要把魔怪逐出我们的世界，就可获得丰厚的赏金，并有机会购买更强大、更加凶残的武器。但若失败，您的角色和装备都会在死后灰飞烟灭。您的经验值则会保留在您的猎人池中——也就是您的 "血脉" 中——永不消散。
高风险、高回报、高紧迫感
《Hunt：Showdown》的高竞争性竞技式玩法结合 PvP 和 PvE 中的元素，在游戏中打造独一无二的紧张气氛，让您无时无刻不提防着自己的生命、角色和装备，以免它们灰飞烟灭。每场赏金猎杀竞赛开始时，最多可有 12 位玩家出发追寻魔怪目标。根据您选择的游戏模式和团队选项，这 12 人中既有单打独斗的玩家，也有二、三人一组的小队。魔怪一旦被寻获并消灭后，玩家就可获得一份赏金，但也将立刻变成地图中其余猎人的目标。一不留神，就会遭人伏击，眼巴巴地看着赏金被夺走，慢慢死去。风险越大，回报也越大。走错一步，万事皆空。
快速竞赛模式的比赛时间更短，期间最多有十位独立的玩家展开角逐，搜集装备，找到并关闭四个裂隙，同时彼此竞争，抢夺不断减少的赏金。率先抵达最终裂隙的猎人可以吸收裂隙的能量，但必须在最终倒计时中存活下来，才能完成任务。同时，率先抵达的猎人还要提防其他觊觎赏金的猎人。计时结束后，胜者可以保留自己的猎人，其余的人则尘归尘、土归土。
游戏进程
即使面临死亡，您也可通过您的血脉，维持并传承您猎人的等级进度。若您的猎人死去，其经验将会转入您的血脉，并可传承到您的其他猎人身上。要是您能成功逃出，就可以使用所赚到的钱财和经验招募新猎人，准备下一场竞赛。如果您死去，除了经验值以外，您将失去一切。
黑暗视域
黑暗视域让猎人们看穿各个世界之间的神秘纱帘，看到常人所看不到的事物。在追踪魔怪时使用黑暗视域，让鬼火带领您到达您下一个目标。黑暗视域也会标记握着赏金的猎人，使他们在逃跑之时更容易遭到他人的埋伏。

It’s enjoyable, sure, but its adaptation doesn’t mesh well with the pace and epic scale that makes Battlefield 6’s regular multiplayer so much fun. But where REDSEC’s battle royale only
The new battle royale isn't without its missteps or annoyances, but it's a solid start that feeds your appetite for destruction.

Too bad that aspects such as the improvable multiplayer, or the "always online", affect the final result.

Beautiful, rich in content, varied in what it offers, The Crew Motorfest is a very good 100% arcade open world racing game. The Ivory Tower software is more effe

critic.quote: Destiny 2 is an epic: a story with an ever expanding scale made greater by the heroes of whom the story is told with tragedy, struggle, and redemption. It is very fitting that the score to accompany it must be, too. And it is. There were moments that I had to put the controller down and simply listen, taking in the scope of what I was experiencing.

Lessons were learnt and learnt well. The looming Darkness has not consumed Bungie at this point in time. Quite the contrary. Destiny 2 is the glorious self-rez fans have been praying for. Stop orbiting it and dive in, today.
Destiny 2 improves upon its predecessor in every conceivable area, resulting in a content-packed, enjoyable FPS that will keep you entertained for months on end.

There’s a lot to enjoy here both solo and as a co-op experience. Any fan of Destiny 1 should take a look at this game, and anyone that has had interest in it but hasn’t pulled the trigger on it just yet should rest easy knowing that while it has a few issues here and there, Destiny 2 is a great game that champions over the first game in so many ways. I highly suggest it to both FPS and RPG fans al

Although Destiny 2 requires quite a lot of grinding, the whole process doesn't really feel like a chore since there are so many varied activities that you'll rarely do the same thing twice in a month (unless it's a weekly activity, or you really want to). First and foremost, Destiny 2 does not frustrate players by placing parts of the end game under hard to achieve power level requirements. There'

The story and gameplay mechanics have greatly improved, and it sports many graphical upgrades. It's unfortunate that the enemy AI isn't more challenging, but for this franchise, the fun will always come from the end-game content. As long as players understand and accept that, they should snap up this sequel and prepare for another long adventure.

critic.quote: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla is another success in the series. We love that it’s starting to look back at older, more classic elements of the franchise and finding ways to reimplement them in an ever-evolving, fresh feeling new game.

Assassin's Creed Valhalla takes the advancements of the series found in Odyssey and applies it to a whole new setting. As brutal as the period of Vikings is, there's something beautiful about this adventure. Every action is rewarded with some great moments of storytelling, and aside from a few narrative roadblocks tied to the player's level, there's an amazing world here just waiting to be discove

If it sufficiently renews the experience of the saga thanks to a rich and functional overall design and an approach that should delight fans of the first hour, Assassin's Creed Valhalla also retains some stigmas of its predecessors that prevent it from aiming a little higher.

It is undeniable that the series is growing, and it’s admirable that the developers are willing to try new things. Overall, the experience works in Assassin’s Creed Valhalla. It’s not a perfect fit, yet, but there’s promise in the series future if they continue to head in a direction that has more RPG elements, and options for a direct approach. It also feels like a proof of concept that they can

Those are minor nitpicks of course, and shouldn't take away from all of the things Valhalla does well. Valhalla builds one of the most immersive and lived-in worlds of the series so far and expertly ties in all of its various mechanics and elements into one delightfully fulfilling experience. It delivers thrilling action and a gratifying narrative while also giving older concepts like the settleme

Valhalla once again proves that ubisoft's chosen path for Assassin's Creed may not be appealing to the old fans of the series, and that's not necessarily a bad thing, as the series have developed into a solid RPG franchise. Still, Valhalla shows that the series is still far from completion, as there are several obvious shortcomings in combat gameplay and AI, along with some visual problems.

Whether you’re playing with a significant other, a friend or a family member, It Takes Two is an essential title for any PS5 owner who is looking for a cooperative challenge and from an incredible moving perspective from a story point of v

It Takes Two is an amazing game that keeps players on their toes with its impeccable pacing in both story and gameplay. This 3D platformer mixes genres every step of the way in a magical ride through different locals. At the center, though, is a great love story full of heartwarming moments and plenty of laughs to boot.

It Takes Two is a beautiful and exciting co-op experience, that can potentially mean so much more for those who relate to this premise. Working together is not always the issue in a relationship, sometimes you just don’t get along. Across all the jumps, boss battles, and deadly puzzles, we get to witness this couple’s journey. From this, we also learn a few pointers on teamwork and having a ton of

It Takes Two is endlessly creative. Gameplay speaks to narrative, while narrative informs gameplay, and the entire experience just feels incredibly polished and detailed. It nails relationships in ways that so many games—and even other forms of media—just can’t. It asks the player to engage with the the story through mandatory co-op to tell the tale of a couple on the verge of divorce, rediscoveri
Just grab a good friend and go play this amazing coop adventure.
A joyful, colourful, and hugely inventive cavalcade of co-op antics that makes superb use of having two players for both its unique challenges and unscripted hijinks.

critic.quote: World Brothers 2 provides excellent upgrades to mechanics from the first game to make this one feel even better to play.

I’m absolutely a fan of the spin-off, with World Brothers 2 carrying on the quick, accessible, and nonsensically entertaining action of its predecessor. It’s packed full of fun toys, drowns the player in content, and you can play as a woman who thinks she’s a horse.  She spawns carrots behind her when she sprints. How is that not what videogames are all about?

Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 is a bit of a mixed bag. It probably has the best gameplay in the series, but loses some of the scope and campiness of the mainline games. Also, the timing of its release is weird, coming out only 2 months after Earth Defense Force 6. While I reviewed the PS5 version of World Brothers 2, and found it ran beautifully, at the time of preorder, the Switch version

In a series that is quickly running out of fresh ideas, World Brothers 2 leans into being fast, fun and cheery. It might struggle to find an audience with both casual players and hardcore EDF fans but it certainly offers up some enjoyable alien blasting action.

While it's not all that different from its predecessor, Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 proves to be a worthy follow-up, offering more missions and more Brothers to collect, and ultimately just being more fun in general. Whether you're an existing fan of the series or want a fun way to dip your toes into it, World Brothers 2 is easy to recommend.
World Brothers 2 is a great introductory title for those new to EDF, as well as longtime fans looking for a more straightforward experience that allows for quicker experimentation.

critic.quote: This definitive remaster elevates an already legendary ARPG to modern heights, showcasing jaw-dropping path tracing, refined animations, and smarter enemy combat. Although movement still carries a slight lingering clunkiness and initial load times remain protracted, the comprehensive mechanical tweaks and bundled expansions make this return to the Continent an absolute masterpiece.

The question isn't whether The Witcher 3 Remastered can still compete in 2026. The real question is which comparable game of the last ten years can go toe-to-toe with it, and that is a very short list.

Without a doubt, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered is the best way to revisit The Witcher 3. It is beautiful, polished, still packed with timeless content, and comes as a free upgrade. The Witcher still has a story that holds up remarkably well today and a world worth exploring, and its quality has always made it better equipped than most games to withstand the passage of time.

The Witcher 3 Remastered doesn’t make the massive RPG feel like a new game, but it does tweak and enhance a number of facets that help smooth over the experience and bring out its best qualities. It’s a fascinating way to return to the shoes of Geralt of Rivia.

The greatest strength of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered is that it gives us an excuse to step back into the shoes of Geralt of Rivia on his journey across the Continent. Years later, it remains thrilling to wield both the steel and silver swords, and this time CD PROJEKT RED delivers an updated, smoother, and more modern combat system. The visuals have been overhauled—particularly the light

We are talking about The Witcher 3, complete with its two excellent DLCs: Blood and Wine, which is richer in terms of content, and Hearts of Stone, which is more artistically striking. The remastering work is polished, save for a few minor hiccups—mostly involving the menus. It is truly hard to pass up, especially considering we need to get ready for Songs of the Past.

多个暗杀名单目标以及不同的潜入和撤离点为你提供了无与伦比的选择权，让你自由决定如何完成目标并创造出自己的游戏风格。
整个战役也可以在合作模式下进行。与盟友一起对抗纳粹战争机器，分享武器、物品和战术知识，并在交火中倒下时互相帮助重新投入战斗。
逼真的X射线击杀镜头和先进的枪战物理效果
标志性的X射线击杀镜头回归，展示每一次标志性射击的真实破坏力。骨头会使子弹偏转方向，不可预测地从新的路径穿透敌人的身体，而冲锋枪和手枪也会触发击杀镜头，以夸张的慢动作展示多发子弹射击。

真实的二战武器和自定义
