s.desc:
传奇制作人 “吹哥” Jonathan Blow（代表作：《时空幻境》《见证者》）携新作《沉星之序》重磅归来。这款宏大的冒险游戏内含 1000 多个手工设计的谜题，旨在考验你的智慧极限。你将踏入充满奇异魔法、危险机关与凶残怪物的异界，探索四个机制迥异、角色鲜明、故事独立的平行世界，最终见证它们彼此交汇碰撞的壮丽景象。随着世界融合、角色相遇，谜题系统也将相互交织，催生出意想不到的全新玩法。按自己的节奏自由探索，随时重返各个世界与挑战。解锁独特的可操作角色，掌握不断演变的游戏机制，逐步剥开这片广阔互联世界的深层秘密。融合探索、叙事与持续蜕变的机制，《沉星之序》将为你呈现一场前所未有、充满生命力的谜境之旅。
数千谜题，交织成篇
踏上这场创意十足的谜题冒险，体验数十种游戏机制与数百小时的独特玩法。每一个谜题都承前启后，引入全新机制，回报你的好奇心与坚持。
自由探索，随心漫游
探索四个庞大而神秘的世界，每个世界都有专属的角色、规则、险境与待发掘的秘密。来去随心，按自己的节奏应对眼前的一切谜题。
化身风格迥异的英雄
女王、盗贼、战士、巫师、乃至一艘会说话的小船……都将是这段传奇的英雄。每位角色都拥有相辅相成的能力与引人入胜的故事。
破解史诗级的谜团
随着角色相遇、世界相互碰撞，谜团逐渐揭晓。通过谜题与收集散落的笔记，你将一步步深入了解这个神秘国度。借助每一条线索、每一片拼图，最终揭开《沉星之序》的终极秘密。

critic.quote: Order of the Sinking Star is a demanding and inventive puzzle adventure that constantly finds new ways to challenge your understanding of its rules. Its four distinct worlds, character-driven limitations, and increasingly intertwined mechanics make solving puzzles deeply satisfying, even if prolonged roadblocks can sometimes become exhausting.

In a darkening world we have to be grateful for games that feel like idiosyncratic and mysterious opuses, because, while they’re never common, I sometimes worry they’re vanishing altogether. I’ve enjoyed every second of my time with Sinking Star, and will enjoy many hours more with it, and it will almost certainly be the most interesting new game to come out this year, GTA 6 included (you can use

There’s no doubt that Order of the Sinking Star is one of the best puzzle games out there. The continual evolution of mechanics sprawling across a puzzle-ridden overworld is vast and exciting, and it’s so cool to see it all come from the same core concept. I like that it tells different stories within this, which leads to the bigger mystery of where we are to begin with. Sometimes it can feel a li

Order of the Sinking Star hands you more than a thousand handcrafted puzzles and no tutorials, and that trust makes it special. Intuitive character abilities, four distinct worlds, and a shared Overworld give every solution a sense of ownership, while undo and restart keep experimentation painless. The same philosophy backfires when progress stalls with no sign of what you missed, and the scale we

Order of the Sinking Star is one of the most fascinating games we’ve played all year. It’s simple but challenging, always keeping the puzzles compelling while implementing new or adaptive mechanics throughout. It does suffer from story woes, and some of the puzzles can be frustrating at times, but still, Order of the Sinking Star remains something for the mind. It’s brilliantly put together, takin

Order of the Sinking Star demands a lot from its players, but rewards them with plenty of variety through four distinct directions, each with its own mechanics, style and story. The lack of hints and increasing difficulty can be frustrating, especially for casual puzzlers, but the way the different systems come together in the Gold Rooms creates satisfying aha-moments. It is a game that trusts pla

s.desc:
重新打开玩具箱，备鞍上马，化身为胡迪、巴斯光年和杰茜，在《Toy Story 3 Complete Edition》中展开一场3D冒险。这款游戏根据2010年热门动画电影《玩具总动员3》改编，更新后不仅拥有更精美的画面，更隐藏了一些新的惊喜。在剧情模式中亲身演绎电影里的经典桥段，或进入玩具盒模式，在胡迪的牛仔乐园中自由探索西部沙盒世界。
在剧情模式中，你将在胡迪、巴斯和杰茜之间自由切换，亲历电影中的标志性场景，包括火车营救、游乐行动、垃圾场逃生等等。发挥每个角色的独特能力，例如用胡迪的拉线摆荡，或借助巴斯的蛮力将其他玩具扔出老远。你还可以双人合作畅玩游戏。
走出剧情模式，进入玩具盒模式的沙盒世界。这个深受粉丝喜爱的自定义模式将你投入胡迪牛仔乐园的西部荒野。和剧情模式一样，你将扮演胡迪、巴斯或杰茜，但在玩具盒模式里，你可以随心所欲地发挥自己的想法！镇上的角色会向你发布任务，完成后可赚取金币，按自己的喜好来打造小镇。建造、装饰并定制建筑，给镇民们换装等等，还有更多精彩内容等你来发现。
《Toy Story 3 Complete Edition》还纳入了此前仅限特定版本的独占内容。现在，玩家可以在玩具盒模式中扮演邪恶皇帝扎克，并解锁四个额外的主题包来装饰玩具盒。此外，完整版还升级了画面、分辨率和帧率。
游戏特色
- 在《Toy Story 3 Complete Edition》中重温这款备受粉丝喜爱的游戏。
- 在剧情模式中重历从安迪的房间到阳光托儿所等的电影精彩桥段。
- 在胡迪、巴斯光年和杰茜之间切换，每个角色都有不同的能力，需要灵活运用才能通关。
- 投入玩具盒模式的沙盒世界。为玩具伙伴们执行任务，给镇民换装，装饰建筑等等。
- 与好友进行本地双人合作，可在剧情模式或玩具盒模式下进行。
- 所有版本现在都包含此前独占的内容，例如在玩具盒模式中扮演扎克皇帝。

critic.quote: With a diverse set of gameplay areas, countless missions, challenges, and collectibles, and the unlimited potential of the Toy Box mode, Toy Story 3 is easily one of the best movie-license games of all times and the perfect way to enhance the film trilogy and carry on the exploits of these delightful and entertaining characters to infinity and beyond…

Toy Story 3 isn't perfect, with some loose controls and a dull plotline to follow, seemingly more for the convention of having a plot in these games than anything else. The Toy Box mode adds a whole lot to the game, however, propelling it far beyond what a typical tie-in game offers.
The co-op levels and action bits are okay, but the Toy Box is magical stuff indeed. [Sept 2010, p.103]

Toy Story 3 is an example of how to do a license right. With great cooperative play, a short, fun story mode, and an inventive new Toy Box mode, this is one game that's easy to recommend to anyone who games with family.
One of the best kids games on 360 but, unusually for Pixar, with little grown-up appeal.  [Oct 2010, p.99]
Toy Story isn't just a game for kids; fans of the trilogy should have no reservations about picking this one up.

s.desc:
啦嗒铛是一款融合了节奏跟横轴动作，可以最多四人一起合作的Roguelike节奏动作游戏。
有100种以上的角色一起展开激烈的大乱斗。
伴随着充满动态节奏感的BGM一起打败敌人吧！
每个人都可以透过节奏与动作结合的惊心动魄的战斗来享受最有趣的冒险。
欢迎来到啦嗒港！
在浩瀚宁静的大海上，有一座像玩具盒一样热闹的岛屿。岛屿的名字是「啦嗒港」
在岛上，一种叫啦嗒铛的疑似动物的奇怪生物跟它们的朋友们一起幸福快乐地生活。
尽管外表和个性各不相同，他们有着一个共同的梦想。
那就是前往「天国」。并遇见据说住在天国的「女神」。
作为肩负着所有人希望的英雄，啦嗒铛们踏上了通往天国的旅程。
无论失败多少次都不会放弃，梦想有一天能见到女神。
动作节奏
配合着音乐输入节奏指令，自由自在地操控着歌宝们吧。
由于啦嗒铛自身能够自由移动，因此在哪里下达指令、将啦嗒铛安置在哪里及何时撤退的判断很关键。
2D动画
我们更注重在2D动画上特有的表现，把活泼的个性投入在动作中。

critic.quote: Ratatan takes everything that was good about its spiritual predecessor and applies it to a faster, roguelike experience that really grooves.

Though the lack of local co-op and some balance issues keep the game from reaching legendary status, Ratatan is still a must-play – especially if you’ve even dipped a toe into Patapon’s world. This is a spiritual successor through and through, nicely evolved with its new gameplay elements and exciting battles. Plus, it looks and sounds like a true entertainer should, running smoothly on the Ninten

Ratatan is a welcome injection of weird into the Switch 2 roster. Hiroyuki Kotani builds on the legacy of Patapon with an addictive musical strategy title that will have “Rata” and “Un-Taka” rattling around your brain long after you walk away from your console. It will please fans of the developer's previous rhythm-action strategy, while offering something fresh and challenging for newcomers. It’s

While not perfectly polished, Ratatan does more than live up to Patapon's whimsical legacy. It takes the delightful rhythm action the PSP gem is known for, and elevates it with roguelike elements that pair with the core gameplay perfectly. The loss of Japan Studio and its excellent experimental games has been keenly felt over the last five years, but new releases like Slitterhead, Ratatan, and eve

As an initial experiment, this Patapon revival works well, though it needs some tweaking—particularly regarding variety and controls. From a technical standpoint, it is certainly not a game worth nitpicking, especially given its price point; having played it on the Nintendo Switch 2, we encountered no performance issues and particularly enjoyed the handheld experience. The artists at Ratata Arts h

Ratatan is a delightful experience that brings back what made the rhythm action and strategy Patapon games so memorable and adds a roguelite structure to the gameplay. Thanks to a marvellous art style, an engaging progression system and an exquisite soundtrack, Ratatan is an absolute charm for fans of the original formula, even if at some moments the on screen action can become visually too packed

s.desc:
​​​​​《星球大战：银河赛车手™》是一款以竞速为核心的惊险赛车游戏，重新定义了赛车游戏的概念，以星球大战™星系的法外之地外环星域为游戏背景。
帝国对银河系的统治终于瓦解，对速度的迷恋随之诞生。在新共和国艰难重建之际，赌博、娱乐和荣耀催生了一个日渐壮大的地下世界。
在这种混乱局面中，银河联赛诞生了：这是一个未经官方认可的赛车联盟，由各大财团赞助飞行员。短短几秒钟就能决定你会赚得盆满钵满，还是输得倾家荡产，只有勇敢者才能生存。
没有原力，没有预言，只有技巧、策略和崛起的意志。
参加惊险竞速
驾驶陆行艇、飞行摩托、滑橇艇和飞梭赛车，在各种赛道上猛烈撞击、左冲右突、终结对手。风险越大，回报就越高。
在危险的地下运动中生存下来
加入银河联赛——一个诞生于法外之地外环星域的非官方赛车联盟。化身为孤胆飞行员幽影，追逐复仇与荣耀。
打造并个性化你的飞行器
驾驶不同类型的反重力飞行器，每种飞行器都有其独特的物理特性和玩法。打造一款能够展现你个人风格并提供竞争优势的飞行器。
在多种游戏模式中与对手展开激战
在剧情驱动的战役中独自驰骋，体验不断变化的联盟关系；或者勇敢地参与策略性的 PvP 复仇之战，一路建立声望。
提升等级，赢取奖励
在激烈的竞争和不断升级的挑战中证明自己。你的每一个选择都将影响你在银河联赛中的地位和前景。

critic.quote: These worlds don't just look beautiful, from Jakku's dunes and wrecked Star Destroyers you must thread between to Crait's white crystalline surface with red dust billowing underneath. They're also carved up into fascinating tracks that blend tight underground corridors where cornering is a constant discussion with death, and daringly wide-open outside sections where I once got so turned around I e
Quotation forthcoming.

Star Wars: Galactic Racer is pretty much everything it should be. Threading the needle between next-gen Burnout and Star Wars-themed racer, it 's frantic, fun and incredibly enjoyable to play. The arcade-style action is a pure delight, and the run-based nature of the campaign gives it a ton of replay value, even if you don 't intend to dip your toes into the multiplayer. If you 're looking for a n
The best Star Wars racing game ever made, which nails the high-speed fantasy while delivering depth, flexibility, and a surprisingly great campaign.

Star Wars Galactic Racer combines exhilarating speed, spectacular collisions and vehicles with distinctly different handling. Its extensive customization and near-roguelite campaign bring real depth to the racing, making every risk matter. Strong visuals and sound create a particularly convincing sense of immersion in the Star Wars universe. However, repetitive environments, on-foot sections that

Overall this is a racing game that’s brutal, so so fast and full of risk and reward at every deadly turn. It fits well in the Star Wars universe and sets out a stall for a whole new resurgence in sci-fi based landspeeder racing.

s.desc:
噬咬、掠夺、逆袭！
《愚者不灭（Stupid Never Dies）》是一款疾速成长系 3D 动作角色扮演游戏。在怪物盘踞的地下异世界中，战五渣小僵尸将以不可思议的速度变得强大无比。
你将扮演潜居怪物社会底层的僵尸戴维，勇闯危机四伏的地下世界，一路吞噬敌人、夺取力量、改造肉身，展开一场不可思议的大冒险。
■ 最弱僵尸爱上葬身冰窟的人类女子。
世界满目疮痍，怪物主宰一切，而人类则在灭绝的边缘苟延残喘。
身为超级孬种僵尸的戴维，偶然在冷库中发现了被冻成冰块的女孩——朱莉娅，并对她一见钟情。
为了解冻“冰棍甜心”，戴维必须一路杀入地下世界最深处，吞噬 KOM（怪物之王），夺回被窃取的人类文明知识结晶。这只被爱情冲昏头脑的废柴僵尸，究竟能否复活朱莉娅，让初恋美梦成真？（顺便……说不定还能拯救世界？！）
■ 别具一格的僵尸动作体验
▼ 异噬
大口啃食精英怪物的核心，获取全新力量。
操纵狼人、吸血鬼、鹰身人等 11 种各具特色的异变，把敌人揍个落花流水。
▼ 身体改造
使用升级后的装备强化各个身体部位。
不同装备组合将彻底改变你的能力与战斗策略。
▼ 戴维爆发
使用特殊能力让现实靠边，尽情发挥疯狂想象。
大幅增强各项属性，在战斗中实现惊天逆转。
■ 狂野的怪物
在超限科技的加持下，吸血鬼、狼人、鹰身人等传说中的生物踏入全新境界！哪怕是同一种怪物，根据身上的装备不同，战斗方式也会大相径庭。

editions.name: Stupid Never Dies: Glorious Idiot Edition

critic.quote: With boldness and charisma, Stupid Never Dies shows some minor stumbles in pacing - or lack thereof - and in the targeting of attacks in certain circumstances, but nothing that diminishes the graphic quality, the intense combat system, and a plot that knows very well how to rely on the fundamental principles of the genre and the thematic absurdity to bring the lightness that the end of the world d

Stupid Never Dies is an explosive debut for GPTRACK50, successfully blending the progression of an action RPG with the frantic, immediate thrill of an arcade roguelite. Despite some rough edges in combat precision—most notably the lack of a lock-on system and a short-ranged parry—Davy's grotesque, punk-infused crusade remains a wildly entertaining, generous, and addictive ride that keeps evolving

Stupid Never Dies is a game that knows what it wants to be, and that is already a good starting point. The transformation system is its best element: it gives the combat rhythm, encourages experimentation and offers enough variety to make the first hours genuinely enjoyable.

An action RPG with roguelike elements, Stupid Never Dies is mostly stupid in the right ways, with its insane experience multiplier feature and switchable forms standing out. The lack of a lock-on feature in combat can be bothersome, though, and you're too often forced to go back to the game's hub when you're enjoying a run.

So much style, so much soul. Playing Stupid Never Dies, you can feel Davy's heart beating. Both because he's in love with his beautiful frozen human and because the game he stars in is a fun and engaging action roguelite. The combat system is solid and packed with moves, and character progression is a dopamine rush, generously doling out power-ups. However, it has made some controversial choices t
A riotously colourful punk-rock action RPG with clever combat systems and bags of personality, Stupid Never Dies is fun once it clicks, though repetition and awkward targeting frustrate.

s.desc:
你曾为拿破仑效力。你曾为拿破仑献出生命。现在，你为了拿破仑起死回生。
你是威廉，一名拿破仑大军团的士兵，你从一个战场坟墓中被唤醒。然而，你眼前的欧洲已不再是你为之牺牲的那片土地。一场神秘的瘟疫此刻正席卷整个大陆，而你之所以会重生，正是因为其腐朽之力在你的血管中奔涌。
驾驭腐朽之力
每一次死亡都是变得更强的契机。熟练掌握由格挡、冲刺和血腥终结技构成，涉及各式武器的战斗系统。正确引导你的力量来强化攻击并解锁新的超自然技能，并将其施展到你的敌人身上。
秘密遍布于战场之上
游走于一段19世纪的平行世界历史之中，在这里无休止的战争早已令整片大地满目疮痍。使用你新获得的机动能力，智取被瘟疫支配的拿破仑永恒卫队怪物，并发现环境中隐藏的秘密，它们可能会提高你的生存机会。
揭露一场惊天阴谋
亲历一个引人入胜的故事，在这个故事里历史人物和现实与恐怖和超自然元素彼此纠缠不清。探索黑暗角落之外的世界，揭露这场瘟疫与你的邪恶重生背后的真相。

武器皮肤包1（2026年秋季推出）

critic.quote: Valor Mortis has become a new favorite of mine. While the game does have its flaws, mostly in the visual clarity of enemy attacks, the problems are so minuscule that they didn’t affect my enjoyment. An inspired setting, a unique twist on the formula, and some incredible body horror make Valor Mortis one hell of a title.

Rather than merely borrowing ideas—from Dark Souls and Dishonored to Sunset Overdrive and even Frogger—One More Level blends them with their own strengths and an original setting to create something truly unique.
Featuring buttery smooth play, fans of first-person melee filled with impactful and meaty combat shouldn't hesitate to check out Valor Mortis.

Valor Mortis proves first-person combat and the soulslike genre are a perfect match. The Ghostrunner studio nails a dynamic blend of steel, gunpowder and magic, with punishing, wildly original bosses and stunning art direction. Only its frustrating platforming and some technical rough edges hold it back.

Valor Mortis finally brings the Napoleonic era to center stage and, building on One More Level’s first-person expertise, succeeds as an action game thanks to satisfying parries, inspired bosses, fun gunplay and a proactive story that, carried by Vincent Cassel’s voice, guides the player to a finale packed with revelations. As a soulslike, however, it lacks the necessary bite, with ever-present lan

Valor Mortis attempts to carve out a place for itself in an increasingly competitive genre thanks to an unusual setting and a combat system that effectively alternates between melee weapons, firearms, and supernatural powers. The idea of blending Napoleonic aesthetics with horror elements is undoubtedly intriguing and helps give the project an identity of its own. However, some concerns remain reg

s.desc:
《PEAK》是一款需要细致合作的登山游戏，作为流落神秘岛屿的童子军探险家，无论单人独闯抑或团队协力，你们唯一获救的希望便是登上岛中那座巍峨的山峰，自然荒野险途漫漫，稍有不慎便会大难临头。顶峰在望，你有魄力能征服它吗？
团队协作
需要搭把手吗？和萍水相逢的朋友患难与共，无论是帮忙登上岩架，抑或是放置绳索岩钉为后来人开路，要想登上日日变换的高山，朋友们的援手是你唯一的依靠。
攀登
大山不讲慈悲！4 种独特的生态地貌横亘在你们前往顶峰的途中，各自有着各自的危险要命套路。寻找一切可疑的食物以求果腹，小心照料身上的伤口——任何不利因素都会限制体能，令你的攀登之途更加险阻。
生存
只做最坏打算：探索多种实用生存道具，能量饮料助你恢复体力，攀岩钢钉助你突破险境，更有神秘的反重绳索等你深挖妙用。唯有善用每一项优势，才能有望征服顶峰。
每天岛屿不重样
游戏地图每 24 小时轮换一次！每天都能体验新的场景布局，或者在一天内盯死同个岛屿重复挑战，直至挑战成功。
赢取奖章
争当老练童军：赢取酷炫外观，用各色奖章向大家证明你才是真正的生存专家！
与友共攀乐趣多
《PEAK》的多人模式仅限好友协力——邀请至多 3 名在线好友一起共攀高峰吧，若是真的够胆，独闯山巅自然未尝不可！
本作特色
在线——跨平台合作；离线——做独狼勇闯
4 名好友共同攀登
近距聊天保持交流
形形色色生态地图等待探索
各种可疑果腹食物
多种独特登山道具
围着营火烤棉花糖
可自定义个性角色
死了还能变成鬼魂

critic.quote: PEAK starts off simple but evolves into a hilarious and strategic co-op game packed with clever mechanics, dynamic biomes, and surprisingly deep gameplay. A charming, fresh must-play at a ridiculously low price.
Peak is everything I'd want from a co-op game. It promotes creative collaboration, is cheap as chips, and with the map resetting every 24 hours there's the possibility of endless fun.

No campaign, no alternative modes. No frills, in short. PEAK focuses on doing one thing, and tries to do it as best as possible. In this case, then, it is one of those rare examples in which the level of fun is directly linked to the people you play it with: its nature makes it perfect as a co-op title to share with a small group of close friends, as long as we are not too scared by the roguelike

PEAK is, well, the peak of climbing games. Aggro Crab and Landfall Games’ combined talent resulted in an incredibly tactile, aptly challenging and delightfully chaotic puzzle platformer. With lots of colour, whimsy and charm, every pitfall or plummet to your death on the trying climb is just another opportunity for you and your friends to pick yourself up off your feet, and get moving again. It’s

PEAK is short, sharp, and brutal—in the best way. Its tight mechanics, clever co-op design, and devilish biomes make every climb memorable, even when the servers don’t hold up. A few bugs and crashes still take away from the experience, but Peak is a game that's wor

s.desc:
永远和羁绊的RPG，《Tales of Eternia》以Remastered 复出！
◆赌上两世界命运的壮阔旅行
伊菲利亚与塞雷斯迪亚，两世界隔着天空对望的对面世界埃达利亚。
主角「里德」和青梅竹马「法拉」，居住在伊菲利亚边境村落拉修安。他们跟从另一个世界塞雷斯迪亚来的少女「梅露蒂」相遇，得知了两世界即将相撞的「大崩落」就近在咫尺。
里德和伙伴们，为了借助掌控万物现象的大晶灵力量来阻止危机，展开了横跨两世界的壮大旅程。
◆快速且高自由性的痛快战斗动作
采用了能发动多样法术招式来持续连击，让战术迥异的伙伴角色联手行动的「主动型 线性动作战斗系统（A-LMBS）」。
能用高速且动感的2D战斗动作来随心所欲摆弄敌人，并享受逐一击倒的爽快战斗。
◆保留完整感动体验，并且更加容易游玩
Remastered版本追加了许多便利功能，如显示目的地图示、关闭遇敌、自动战斗的高速模式等等。
能更加舒适地游玩游戏。另外，画面与特效也能用模式切换功能来体验原始版的氛围。

editions.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered 数字豪华版 PS4 & PS5
Tales of Eternia Remastered PS4 & PS5

critic.quote: I enjoyed my time with Tales of Eternia Remastered; it’s charming, with a lot of heart and narrative depth. I think those who haven’t played a version of Tales of Eternia yet, as well as those who also have the patience for occasionally dated gameplay elements, should definitely give Tales of Eternia Remastered a try. It’s an updated take on a game that could understandably be considered a PS1 cla

Tales of Eternia Remastered brings a 25-year-old classic to modern platforms with a rather conservative approach. Its charming story and enjoyable combat still hold up, despite some dated mechanics and occasional complexities. While the new quality-of-life improvements make the experience smoother and more accessible, they feel somewhat limited, leaving the impression that this remaster could have

Tales of Eternia Remastered successfully brings Bandai Namco’s classic JRPG into the modern era, offering newcomers an ideal entry point to a 2000s gem. Driven by a charming narrative across the twin worlds of Inferia and Celestia, the adventure shines thanks to a dynamic 2D real-time combat system that has aged remarkably well. Thanks to a clean visual overhaul at 60 fps and crucial QOL addition

Tales of Eternia has always been a fan favorite for a reason. The characters are top-tier, the combat system was ahead of its time, and some newly added features laid the groundwork for modern entries in the series. However, that's mostly nostalgia talking, and we all know how much weight that carries. Strip all that away, and you have a game that's a tough sell for newcomers, both to the Tales se

Tales of Eternia Remastered brings back a classic 2D Tales adventure, restoring exclusive content cut from prior North American releases, made complete with some choice QoL improvements for modern audiences.
Tales of Eternia deserved a comeback, as it is a deeply cherished entry among fans of the franchise. It is a decent remastered version, but without any major new features.

s.desc:
你的女儿被绑架了。在这部三部曲的最终章中，你将踏入一场噩梦，拯救她，在追捕你的威胁中求生，并通过“回溯记忆”、镜面能力以及操控飞蛾，揭开“红修女”的真相。本作以意大利新黄色电影风格为特色，将经典生存恐怖题材带入现代。
主要特色
在恐怖的追踪者中求生
挑战你的求生本能，逃离杀人魔的追杀：在危急时刻藏身、闪避并反击。任何失误都可能致命。
掌握催眠之力
运用逆向记忆、镜像能力与飞蛾操控，读取被遗忘的记忆，揭示隐秘路径，并扭转环境以利己。
现代版经典生存恐怖回归
踏入这封致经典第三人称生存恐怖游戏的“情书”，体验现代化的节奏、操控与制作水准。
探索细节丰富的环境
搜查每个房间，寻找线索和关键物品，解开谜题以进入新区域，并朝着最终真相迈进。
揭开“垂死基督”的秘密
揭开西西里修道院那段被遗忘的往事——"红修女"传说的起源地：这里充斥着被焚毁的信仰、被埋葬的罪恶与禁忌的仪式。
广受赞誉的音乐与配音阵容：
传奇作曲家山冈晃创作的原声配乐
英国电影和电视艺术学院游戏奖得主西西·琼斯 饰演苏珊
《The Game Awards》得主玛吉·罗伯逊 饰演红修女
《红修女的遗产》旨在同时吸引《Remothered》系列的新玩家与老粉丝，这款现代生存恐怖游戏受经典恐怖游戏启发，融合了潜行与心理恐怖元素，并引入了以感知、催眠和环境操控为核心的新机制，将彻底终结红修女的故事。
故事简介
有时，追寻真相意味着迷失自我。
六名少女在西西里岛失踪一年多后，一条新线索重新开启了这场噩梦。
当一段神秘录音重燃了女儿可能还活着的希望时，苏珊不顾一切理智，决定前往一切似乎始于此地的地方：一座位于埃特纳火山山坡上、与世隔绝的破败贵族宅邸，这里曾是阿什曼家族的产业。
这场始于绝望的搜寻，很快演变成一场充满恐怖的旅程，其中家族秘密、记忆与执念交织缠绕。苏珊发现自己被卷入了一个由无情的跟踪者、隐秘的符号和催眠现象构成的迷宫。随着现实支离破碎、黑暗力量崛起，她每迈出一步，都离真相更近一步……同时也离一种比她自己更古老的恐怖更近一步。

editions.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy - Deluxe Edition

critic.quote: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy is a satisfying end to the Remothered Trilogy and delivers some disturbing visuals and storytelling. Though its run-and-hide mechanics don't add anything original to the franchise, it more than makes up for it with a strong story, fantastic sound design, and satisfying puzzle-solving.

The third and supposed final chapter of the Remothered series is a solid survival horror experience with a dark and unsettling story that grips you from the outset. Its gameplay is ultimately quite simple, though, and once you've watched the credits roll there's little reason to return.

Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy finally brings the tragic tale of the Ashmann family to a close, offering satisfying narrative answers and a solid art direction backed by Akira Yamaoka's evocative score. Unfortunately, the gameplay is a noticeable step backward from Tormented Fathers. Stripped of dynamic environmental interactions, the stealth mechanics feel shallow, and the poorly scripted stalkers

s.desc:
说“茄子”！
布鲁伊和宾果找到了爸爸的老相机（当年他还挺酷）。
带着相机环游布鲁伊的世界，拍下她们玩的游戏和发现的野生动物。每张照片都会保存到布鲁伊的剪贴簿中，玩家可以在此保存最喜欢的瞬间。
游戏开始！
加入深受大家喜爱的蓝脚牧牛犬布鲁伊的欢乐快照，开启一场热门动画主题的趣味互动
冒险。探索熟悉的场景，畅玩各种玩具，追逐调皮的垃圾鸟，与布鲁伊、宾果和朋友们一起享受欢乐时光！
捕捉美好，收集欢乐，尽情玩耍！
用相机捕捉精彩瞬间，解锁各种贴纸和装饰品，打造你的专属剪贴簿。
涂色、整理照片，亲手制作充满布鲁伊乐趣的专属纪念品。当玩家探索各个游戏场景时，他们还会遇到“为真实生活”设计的活动创意。这些创意能同时激发游戏内与屏幕外的游玩乐趣！
分享快乐！
在伙伴模式下与好友并肩开启冒险之旅。
当主玩家在镜头后引领冒险时，第二位玩家可加入其中，共同探索并摆出趣味造型。你们甚至还可以在冒险途中一起玩玩具！
《布鲁伊的欢乐快照》没有游戏内购项目，也不支持在线游玩。
《Bluey's Happy Snaps》发售当日即可完整体验，并提供以下语言的本地化文本：英语（澳大利亚）、英语（美国）、德语、日语、西班牙语（卡斯蒂利亚）、西班牙语（拉丁美洲）、葡萄牙语（巴西）、简体中文、繁体中文、法语和意大利语。非英语本地化配音将于游戏发售后不久通过免费更新追加，下载更新需要连接互联网，支持的语言包括：下载免费更新需要连接互联网，支持的语言包括：西班牙语（卡斯蒂利亚）、西班牙语（拉丁美洲）、法语、德语、意大利语、日语、葡萄牙语（巴西）以及普通话。请查看blueyshappysnapsgame.com，获得更多信息。

editions.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps：豪华版
features: 额外数字内容“奶奶们来啦

critic.quote: Bluey’s Happy Snap captures the heart of the TV show and puts it into video game form. The game’s graphics let you see the world of Bluey as never before, and the fun you can have taking photos, finding secrets and completing your scrapbook is just the sweetest. It’s a real joy to play with your kid, or just let them have a go at it and help out when needed.

Overall, Bluey’s Happy Snaps does exactly what it sets out to do. It takes players on a journey into Bluey’s world, bringing everything to life in style. The locations, characters, and collectibles add to an interactive and enjoyable experience that truly shines.

Bluey's Happy Snaps is a family fun filled experience aimed at empowering kids to own their game time. It feels like a genuine Bluey episode that immerses players into the whacky adventures of the Heeler family, whilst providing easy controls and mechanics kids will love. Although replayability is dictated by how kids wish to tackle post game content, Happy Snaps will keep them smiling from play o

Bluey’s Happy Snaps is quite clearly built with a younger audience in mind, but don’t let that fool you into thinking it’s little more than a lazy cash-in on a popular franchise. There’s a notable level of care taken in bringing Bluey’s world to life here, and with plenty of things to snap and activities to try, Bluey’s Happy Snaps is a wonderfully fun time for kids and their parents alike.
Bluey's Happy Snaps' photography theme justifies another virtual romp through Bluey's world, though it can't quite escape feeling like a tablet game blown up for consoles.
Snafus aside, Bluey's Happy Snaps is an evergreen recommendation for hardcore fans of the show. If you're diving in for the first time, there are better ways to get acclimated.

s.desc:
携手神探狗狗和他的超级伙伴，踏上超级酷炫的全新冒险旅程！这是一款漫画书般的游戏。这里不仅有惊险动作、搞笑幽默，还有刺激的 BOSS 战和带来特殊能力的新发明。多达 10 名来自原版漫画的角色可供操作，他们各自有各自的奇妙本领。
英雄出马的时候到了！Dr. Scum在全城布置了催眠屏幕，让无辜的居民们听从自己的使唤。事到如今，只有半人半狗的犯罪克星神探狗狗，才能对抗Dr. Scum和他的邪恶军团。打败Dr. Scum，拯救朋友们，从坏蛋手中夺回城市吧！
本游戏改编自由戴夫·皮尔奇创作的精彩漫画系列《神探狗狗》。《内裤超人》也是他的知名作品。
《汪者归来》游戏特色：
和超级伙伴们携手闯关
神探狗狗和他的超级伙伴——包括小彼蒂与超怕80，任你随心操作、随时切换。每位伙伴都有属于自己的特殊能力，可以越过障碍、抗击Dr. Scum。除了超级伙伴们，还可以电话呼叫Commander Cupcake和警长等好朋友前来协助，可操作角色共有 10 位之多！
多达 60 个精彩关卡
从猫咪监狱到机械时代公司，神探狗狗宇宙中种种耳熟能详的经典场景等你来探索。不仅能在限时挑战中与时间赛跑，更有机会发掘神秘关中暗藏的层层惊喜！
独乐乐，也能众乐乐
叫上第二位玩家，运用独一无二的特殊能力，让紧张刺激的闯关乐趣加倍。一起坐上沙发，享受合家欢乐的游戏时光吧！
解锁神秘装扮，打造超级发明
收集小齿轮，解锁炫到没边的神奇发明。收集线团，可以制作Scarlet Shedder、猫小子等超多超酷新装扮！
抗击邪恶大反派
施展每位角色的经典绝招，击败Dr. Scum手下的邪恶小兵，一路冲锋到超级大反派面前。灵活协作，用智慧击败 BOSS 吧！

critic.quote: Dog Man: Bark in Action is exactly the sort of licensed children’s game I want to see more often. It understands the license, captures Dav Pilkey’s strange little world and gives children plenty of familiar characters to recognize, but there is also a genuinely good 2D platformer underneath it. The difficulty is forgiving enough that younger players can make progress without constantly handing ove

Dog Man: Bark in Action is a great platformer for people with less experience in the genre. For those with a bit more platforming under their belt, though, it still manages to be a worthwhile genre inclusion, even if it doesn’t always feel particularly challenging. At the very least, it's an endearing and cute game that manages to evoke the basic reaction one should want from a video game: fun.

critic.quote: To Nintendo fans who haven’t experienced Kingdom Hearts in its full splendor, this is an incredible time to jump in. These games are largely excellent action RPGs that are jam-packed with an out-there emotional story filled with oodles of Disney and Square Enix references.

Nomura’s legacy rolls out the red carpet for Nintendo fans, with everything a native Switch 2 release entails: the unmatched appeal of handheld play, the inevitable performance and frame rate scrutiny, and the ultimate runway setting up Kingdom Hearts 4.

Kingdom Hearts Collection [I–III] is the definitive collection of the series, offering everything fans need to know to prepare for the fourth numbered entry. A highlight is the Switch 2 version, which finally allows console owners to run the games natively and with good performance.

Overall, Kingdom Hearts Collection 1-3 on Switch 2 is a fantastic package that is so close to being completely on par with the Integrum Masterpiece release. Kingdom Hearts 3 and A Fragmentary Passage’s framerate issues are the only things stopping it from definitively being my new favourite way to play, but the ability to go portable is worth those minor issues. Whether you’re a complete newcomer

Kingdom Hearts Collection I-III offers an excellent way to experience nearly the entire series on Nintendo Switch 2, delivering strong performance across most of its titles and the considerable appeal of playing these adventures in handheld mode. Although Kingdom Hearts III and Kingdom Hearts 0.2 suffer from some technical issues, the collection remains a fantastic package for both newcomers and l

Kingdom Hearts Collection [I～III] is the best way to play the whole saga, in order. The classics show their age and Kingdom Hearts III hovers between 40 and 50 FPS, but Switch 2 still runs the collection well.

s.desc:
踏入斗兽场，与朋友们锁链相连。
CHAINED BEASTS 是一款 1至4人合作的角斗士 Roguelike 游戏，结合了残酷的战斗、团队合作与荒诞滑稽的时刻。你能否召集伙伴、击碎敌人、赢得观众，并夺回自由？
角斗士战斗
在这款残酷的角斗士 Roguelike 中劈砍敌人，或利用环境来反制他们。向敌人掷出陶罐，或把敌人丢向陶罐。将他们撞入带刺的墙壁或蛇坑之中。投掷武器可远距离击倒敌人，但请确保手边还有另一件武器，否则你可能陷入险境。
与伙伴锁链相连
不要独自奋战，召集四位凶猛的伙伴，你们将以残酷又富创意的方式被锁在一起。若无法协调，你们可能会纠缠在柱子上，甚至更糟。但若步调一致，你们就能绊倒敌人，逆转局势。
对抗残暴首领
随着声名的提升，你将面对残暴的首领，竞技场中的英雄，他们武装到牙齿，拥有一切优势。局势将极度不利于你，但胜利会让你离罗马更近一步，迎来自由或复仇的机会。
挣扎于恐怖伤痛
竞技场的每一天都会让你增添新的伤口与痛苦。拖着受伤的腿前行，带着失去左眼的视野求生，或在幻觉中胡乱挥舞。药剂或许能缓解痛楚，但副作用可能让你陷入更严重的折磨。也许手术才是唯一的出路。
苦难淬炼性格
不要失去希望，在竞技场的磨炼中，你也能被锻造成残酷的战士。学习强大的技能以击败敌人。赢得观众，他们将永远为你呐喊助威。积攒金币，购买能扭转战局的装备与武器。解锁拥有强大能力的新角色。每一次战斗，都将迫使你踏上不同的道路。

critic.quote: Chained Beasts stands out for its inventive chain mechanic and demanding cooperative gameplay, but as a roguelike, it quickly falls into the trap of repetitiveness. A solid foundation isn't enough when successive runs offer too little variety or incentive to keep playing.

s.desc:
你将扮演狐狸记者“托马斯”，在严酷的监狱中生存、探索和逃脱。努力收集证据，洗清冤屈。结交个性十足的囚犯，在阴谋重重的险境中闯出一条生路！卧底警探黑豹“鲍勃”现已登场，快来体验惊心动魄的CRPG冒险吧！
■电影感十足的硬汉派叙事
玩家将置身于动物之城，扮演遭受陷害的记者和执行卧底任务的警察，试着在严酷的监狱中生存下来。与监狱外的伙伴里应外合，收集证据，调查一切可疑的踪迹，在危难之中拯救自己和这座城市。
■内容庞大而充实的纯正CRPG
本作不仅为玩家可操作的两位主角各准备了超过20小时的精彩主线故事，还有3大监狱帮派，47名个性十足的囚犯，数十位特色各异的NPC，上百个精心设计的任务，多条体验迥异的越狱路线，外加丰富的结局分支，以及超过百万字的生动文本，这一切的元素将打造出前所未有的角色扮演体验！
■深入调查潜藏于监狱的秘密阴谋
看似井然有序的监狱，其实暗藏玄机？监狱角落的不速之客，食堂暗门后的诡异声响，走廊尽头那道永远上锁的门……收集蛛丝马迹，交易情报，在深夜宵禁时段展开冒险，与时间赛跑，揭开隐藏在监狱里的阴谋与秘密！
■沉浸感十足的牢狱生活体验
彻底融入这座庞大的监狱，严格遵守狱中规定，同时将它化为你的表演舞台，大展身手。探索陌生的环境，迎接种种未知的挑战。是当个安稳度日的模范囚犯，还是四处惹是生非大搞破坏，这一切都将由你决定。
■个性十足的登场角色
这座监狱里的每个角色都拥有令人难以忘怀的故事。要与他们交流合作、相互帮助（或相互利用），还是狠狠地踢他们的屁股，全看你的选择！当然也可以做个“独行侠”，或在各个势力间巧妙周旋。是贯彻正义还是耍点手段，而既然进了监狱，不妨试着入乡随俗。
■自由开放的成长系统
做个用拳头说话的硬汉，或是藏于阴影中的盗贼；想要巧舌如簧外加一点黑客技术？当然，在这里一切皆有可能。学习技能，收集装备，制作工具，试着从无名的菜鸟囚犯成长为耀眼的监狱之星吧！
■大开脑洞的越狱路线
从洗衣房到医务室，再到下水道和停车场，成功越狱的关键潜藏在监狱的每一处角落。发现每个场景中的秘密，然后善用它们，自由之路上，你的想象力将成为最有力的武器。

editions.name: 动物迷城 ～Back to the Dawn～

critic.quote: Back to the Dawn is one of the most unique indie RPGs I’ve played in recent memory—gritty, tense, mechanically rewarding, and full of well-developed characters who surprise you with their humanity, despite being cartoon animals. Its depiction of prison life is thoughtful and serious without relying on shock value, and the branching narrative gives your decisions real weight.

Back to the Dawn is a management RPG set in a prison populated by anthropomorphic animals, with strong survival elements. You have twenty-one days to organize an escape, keeping an eye on time, resources, social relationships, and skills. Every action consumes precious minutes and can influence future events. The turn-based combat system mirrors typical JRPG gameplay. Deep, branching, and challeng

Back to the Dawn is a smart, content-rich RPG that encourages creative problem-solving and experimentation. With two distinct protagonists, an open structure, and a wide cast of characters, it’s a great fit for players who love choice-driven gameplay and tactical planning. While some areas (like the combat system or portrayal of female characters) could use further depth, the overall experience is
For a game set in a jail, Back to the Dawn offers an impressive amount of freedom. Coupled with a conspiracy-minded story, and more side-quests you can shake a shiv at, you'll be hooked.
Metal Head takes the mechanics of time, skill and priority management very seriously, and delivers a rich, immersive and gripping narrative experience, with a gallery of engaging characters.
Back to the Dawn is a prison RPG with great in-game time mechanics, a good story and a lot of replayability. Some of its narrative choices, however, are a little too stereotypical.

s.desc:
横跨六十年的沉浸式体验
每个年代都有专属的视觉风格和精选热门歌单，你可以随心穿梭各个音乐时代，或是一站式打造从怀旧金曲到现代流行的终极歌单，全程体验流畅无缝。全新冒险模式带你解锁全部内容，这是一段轻松治愈、以剧情串联的旅程，伴着舞步走遍流行音乐的璀璨年代。
在全民熟知的歌曲中起舞
跨越世代的传世金曲搭配专属编舞，尽情狂欢，玩家人气曲目包含：
- Bad Bunny 的《NUEVAYoL》
- Sabrina Carpenter 的《Manchild》
- Lucenzo & Don Omar 的《Danza Kuduro》
- DJ Snake & Lil Jon 的《Turn Down for What》
- Gorillaz 的《Feel Good Inc.》
- *NSYNC 的《Bye Bye Bye》
- Spice Girls 的《Wannabe》
- TLC 的《No Scrubs》
- Run DMC 的《It's Tricky》
- Billy Joel 的《Uptown Girl》
- ABBA 的《Mamma Mia》
还有更多好歌等你体验！
既有简单易上手的曲目，也有极具挑战的编舞，今年的歌单能让全年龄段、不同风格的玩家一同欢乐！
全世代共享趣味冒险
在全新的冒险模式中，共同探索音乐年代。游历六大主题世界，跟随经典歌曲舞动，游玩趣味小游戏，解锁专属奖励。该模式仅在《舞力全开：传世金曲》开放！
花样派对，欢乐不停
本地最多支持 6 人同跳，开启派对模式尽情狂欢，或是选择健身模式边跳边燃脂。约上亲朋好友，挑选喜爱模式或曲目，派对即刻开场！
在线多人游戏或功能需要网络连接、Ubisoft 账户、PlayStation™Network 帐户和订阅 PlayStation®Plus 订阅服务（单独出售）。

critic.quote: As a trip through six decades of music, the song selection choice is mostly very strong, with fun new dances for everyone – and the surprise, welcome return of fan-favourite stop-motion hero Lizzy in Celebration. This year’s Just Dance is a worthy entry for new and returning players alike.
Just Dance: Decades of Hits is a wonderfully entertaining game, and the only thing more fun than playing it is watching someone else dance

A Just Dance that changes its name more than its formula. While the new Adventure Mode adds little to the experience, the game is still the perfect excuse to get everyone off the couch and onto the dance floor.

Just Dance: Decades of Hits is one of the strongest entries in the series in recent years, offering a diverse tracklist, colorful choreography, and a fun Adventure Mode. The return of multiple Dancer Cards is a welcome improvement, especially for multiplayer fans. However, inaccurate Joy-Con tracking, limited camera controller support, and a lack of variety in Adventure Mode hold it back slightly.

Just Dance: Decades of Hits works where it matters. At the end of the day it’s a fun workout game that allows for a lot of flexibility when it comes to the song choice. It has an annoying but ultimately unobtrusive way of asking you to spend more money, but if you find the main game is worth it, who's to say the extras aren’t worth it to you, too?

users.author: MrCadell
users.quote: One of the best JD games in the series, with simple but really high-quality choreography, full of replay value, and having the essence of classic, older entries like JD4-JD16. The song list includes recognizable hits from various decades that appeal to all age groups. Recommended for sure.

s.desc:
《The Witch’s Bakery》是一款温馨惬意的冒险RPG。成为可爱快乐的小女巫，在当代巴黎开一家属于自己的烘焙坊，用你的超能力洞察人心，然后施放魔法治愈心伤！
巴黎女巫烘焙师日常
小女巫露恩是这座城市中的萌新！每天的生活分为三个阶段：
白天：露恩驻守烘焙坊，施展小小的魔法帮顾客化解烦恼。
傍晚：露恩会在傍晚探索巴黎，与他人建立纽带，发现这座城市的秘密，一探朋友心中的困扰和烦恼。
深夜：在温馨舒适的工作室中放松身心，提高魔法技能，装点烘焙小店。
随着日子一天天过去，游戏不断推进，你会获得更多的经验、资金和名气，邂逅更多的朋友，并治愈他们的心灵。
缤纷巴黎的快乐冒险！
完成一天辛苦的工作，你可以前往巴黎的各个行政区，遇见各位主要角色，参加多种活动，学习新技能，选购新的食谱书等等。
从蒙马特、林荫大道等名区街道，到只有本地人知晓的隐秘瑰宝，巴黎的无尽奇妙等你探索。每个区都有独一无二的角色、活动和店铺哦！
发现心中的情感与柔软
有时候，我们会将感情压抑到最深处，锁在最难找到的角落。而为了帮助他人，露恩需要深入思想与感情诞生的奇妙地方——“心之宫殿”，引导拟人化的感情回归心灵。
在心之宫殿中，露恩会了解到每个人最隐秘的烦恼与忧愁，然后找到所需的关键原料，烘焙出能治愈人心的面包！

critic.quote: Balancing Lunne’s business, relationships, and magical growth as a Heart Witch was one of the best gaming experiences I’ve had all year. With each passing in-game day, I fell more in love with the world and everyone in it. Now, I only want more players to experience the same joy I’ve had with The Witch’s Bakery, so do not let this one go overlooked.

The Witch's Bakery features a wholesome story with different types of gameplay. Lunne and Orio are a great pair who genuinely want to help the people in Paris, despite how nosy Lunne may seem. It has charm, an engaging story, and a fresh spin on the cozy bakery shop genre.

s.desc: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest是一款沉浸式动作冒险游戏，背景设定在备受喜爱的《猫武士》系列小说中的蛮荒野地。你将踏上各种各样的任务，以赢取族群的青睐，并在回合制战斗中与其他族群较量，以此强化你的猫、铸就你的传奇。学习新的战斗招式来击败对手。遭遇丰富多样的敌人，包括老鼠、松鼠、獾等，最终还将迎来史诗级战斗。在土地上搜寻，找到可用于在巢穴中制作物品的材料。穿越标志性的领地，包括雷族茂密的森林、河族的沼泽地、影族阴暗的松树湿地，以及风族开阔的荒原。你的冒险还将带你前往著名的神圣地点——月亮池和岛屿。攀爬树木、跃过灌木丛、追踪气味、破解环境谜题，并揭开星族自身的秘密。

s.desc:
多人联机！狂欢加倍
同心协力，天下无敌？
《霓虹深渊2》最多支持4人联机游玩，准备叫上你的朋友一同开启这场全新的冒险吧！天知道你们会遇到些什么～
全新 4 人合作模式！
同心协力，天下无敌！
《Neon Abyss 2》将推出刺激的在线 4 人合作模式，让你能与最多三名好友一起深入这款混乱的 Roguelike 游戏。携手合作，让独特的协作与连击效果加倍，并打造强大的毁灭之力。搭配彼此的配置，一起征服深渊；你们甚至还能以最高效率探索同一张地图，找出隐藏的秘密与宝藏。
武器天马行空
战斗系统颠覆性革新！
从挥舞球棒或光剑，到种植花朵攻击敌人，再到指挥神龙帮你作战——打开脑洞，尽情尝试各种奇思妙想的作战方式！
道具无限叠加
没错，依旧强到变态！
获得道具赋予你千奇百怪的能力，这些能力还能相互联动，叠加数量更是没有限制。让敌人见识谁才是真正的 BOSS！
进化吧小可爱
哈基宝！就决定是你了！
孵化并收集各种颜色的哈基宝（宠物），将它们组合进化成更强大的超级哈基宝。每只哈基宝都拥有独特的能力和机制，为游戏带来丰富多样的玩法。
信仰化为现实
快速成长，逆风翻盘！
全新的信仰系统赋予你运筹帷幄的能力。在宏伟的赌场中一决胜负，在琳琅满目的商店里尽情挥霍，或在萌宠乐园孵化可爱的哈基宝。
还有…更多？
惊喜远不止这些！
神秘未知的邪恶力量，从未谋面的赛博新神，全面升级的宝物和战利品……还有更多全新系统和机制等待你挖掘。全副武装，同心协力，准备迎接新一轮的冒险吧！

critic.quote: A cracking rogue-like shooter that builds on the solid foundation of the previous game, Neon Abyss 2 offers countless hours of frantic fun.

Neon Abyss 2 is a solid addition to today's indie roguelike scene. It manages to stand out thanks to its fun and frantic combat, exploration that encourages experimenting with different builds using randomly discovered items, and challenging enemy design. While its overall structure doesn't feel particularly innovative and its guidance can sometimes be unclear, it's still an experience well worth

Overall, I really enjoyed my time with Neon Abyss 2. It’s fun, easy to pick up and play, has a ton of progression systems to keep you hooked, and customization to make runs as easy or hard as you want. I would’ve loved more opportunities to create proper builds rather than having mostly incremental upgrades each run, which could have added an extra layer of complexity that the best-in-class games

For better or for worse, Neon Abyss 2 feels very much like more Neon Abyss. But some meaningful changes in progression and permanent upgrades, along with a whole new way to play, make this zany roguelike just as gloriously addictive as the first game ever was.

Neon Abyss 2 is a beautiful sequel, with bolder visuals, flashier weapons and more game-breaking strategies. Unfortunately, the difficulty drops fast once you find the right item combination. The flashy gameplay is fun, but finding a game-breaking strategy happens a bit too quickly. The light show it creates is a joy to behold, yet I couldn’t shake the feeling that I, not the bosses, was the overp

s.desc:
为了遏制“沦落城市”的地下犯罪世界，一场残酷的战斗如火如荼地拉开帷幕：四个陌生人并肩作战，一边努力生存，一边收复街区！面对狼一般凶悍的匪徒，这些不同寻常的战友们将面对不同寻常的局势。在战斗过程中，决胜的动力会与往日的生活发生冲突，进一步考验他们的忠诚和战力。只有齐心协力，他们才能挨到你死我活的最后决战。
《Fallen City Brawl》汲取了上世纪 80 年代末和 90 年代初街机清版动作游戏的精华，通过激烈的横向卷轴像素艺术动作场面讲述了一个展现抱负和复仇的故事。巨大的精灵图和动画背景为奄奄一息的城市街道注入了生活气息，同时战斗机制也达到不同寻常的深度，采用了毁灭性的组合连击、反击、腾空抛、扭打、格挡、绝招和“狂暴”绝技！过场动画，加上著名作曲家 Daniel Lindholm 创作的精彩配乐，烘托出城市乱象的基调，无论是在单人模式中，还是在有好友参与的本地合作模式中，均可欣赏！
游戏特点：
• 一路拼杀，通过 7 个街机式动作阶段！
• 在 4 个玩家角色中进行选择。
• 玩转深不可测的近身格斗机制，执行组合连击和绝招。
• 捡起各种武器，如铁管、球棒、小刀、枪支、油桶、链锯等等！
• 通过让可升级的雇佣后备军展开特别攻击来清理屏幕。
• 以单人模式或有好友参与的本地合作模式决一死战。
• 指挥狼伴或让其自由发挥，然后观看屠杀！
• 在 Daniel Lindholm 创作的配乐中感受混乱的气氛。

critic.quote: Fallen City Brawl is a game that, despite its limits, manages to entertain. It’s a short but intense experience, ideal for those who want to relive the atmosphere of pinball machines and arcades. The graphical imperfections, the questionable weapon balancing, and a certain lack of polish keep it away from excellence, but the beating heart of the beat ’em up is there—and it beats strong.
Fallen City Brawl is a fun beat ’em up experience, but it doesn’t have any replay value. I also wish there was a bit more substance to the story in levels.

Fallen City Brawl won me over on vibes and thematic. Its gameplay, while frenetic and fun, needs more depth to exceed the current gold standard utilized by recent additions to the modern beat-em-up genre. It’s great for a quick afternoon playthrough, especially when played with friends.
Heavily inspired by Streets of Rage and Final Fight, Fallen City Brawl is a retro-styled side-scrolling beat 'em up that has some some unique ideas but ultimately falls short in a number of areas.

Fallen City Brawl has its strengths, with its crunchy combat, a solid variety of weapons, and a fantastic soundtrack. But those high points are often dragged down by inconsistent visuals, a lack of polish, and some frustrating design decisions. With more time and refinement, it could’ve stood alongside the genre’s modern greats like Streets of Rage 4 or TMNT: Shredder’s Revenge. As it is, it’s a d

s.desc:
在这款剧情驱动的开放世界RPG中，选择成为战士、Volkhv或弓箭手，踏上前往Borea大地的旅程。揭开污染森林与野生生物的黑暗源头，完成100多个各具特色的任务，加入两大阵营之一，并通过成长、主动与被动技能以及角色属性塑造你的英雄。
探索多样生态群系和三座大型聚落，发现秘密与致敬内容，精通炼金、烹饪、锻造、附魔、钓鱼、珠宝制作等深度制作系统。选择适合你的难度模式，从注重剧情的冒险到限制存档的硬核挑战。

《四海兄弟III：最终版》现已登陆 PlayStation®5，支持 60 帧游戏帧率，并带来多项技术优化。
新波尔多，1968 年。在美国东南部猖獗的犯罪黑潮之中，为一场残酷的背叛复仇。林肯・克雷从越南历经数年战火归来，他的寄养家族 —— 黑人黑帮，遭到意大利黑手党的背信出卖并惨遭屠戮。林肯在旧家族的废墟之上建立起新的势力，向一众黑手党徒展开复仇。林肯・克雷深谙这样一个道理：家人不在于与生俱来的血缘，而在于你愿意为之舍命的人。
《四海兄弟III：最终版》包含主游戏、所有追加内容（《更快，宝贝！》、《失转的石头》、《时代标志》）以及捆绑在一起的奖励包（家族返利包以及法官、陪审团和的执行者武器包）。
新波尔多，洛杉矶
在这座由黑手党掌控的路易斯安那城市开辟你的势力，沉浸式感受那个时代的声色风貌。
以自己的方式复仇
选择自己的游戏风格——蛮力、燃烧枪支或跟踪杀戮战术——摧毁《四海兄弟》。
旧家族废墟上的新家族
按你的方式打造全新犯罪帝国，决定哪些副手该予以奖赏，又有哪些要被你背叛。

critic.quote: Mafia III may still have a ridiculous amount of glitches yet its plot is fantastically gripping from start to finish. So, if you enjoy character-driven stories set in open worlds then you'll be impressed with what it has to offer.

Mafia III: Definitive Edition on Xbox One has distinct charm in its narrative, world-building and conceptualised understanding of socio-politics and the military-industrial complex but, ironically enough, it fails in its combat and general movement. Whilst it is clear a great deal of care has gone into its writing, I wish I could say the same for its gameplay.

While not anywhere near as glitch ridden as the Mafia II remaster, Mafia III: Definitive Edition adds nothing more than the previously released DLC along with the very strange removal of Xbox One X support that was added to the original release after launch. Lincoln Clay's story is well worth experiencing a first time, but there is no real reason to venture back to New Bordeaux with this latest re

s.desc:
拥抱未知并穿越一个广袤的外星世界，其中充斥着怪异的生物、致命的危害以及冷酷的谜团。找寻救赎，并直面埋藏于被遗忘的普罗蒂亚六号行星深处的恐怖罪孽。
-探索一片超凡脱俗的废土之地
无论你是试图体验荒芜的地表，攀登致命、严寒的山峰，还是探查爬满了恶毒外星物种的研究设施，普罗蒂亚六号上隐藏着大量可供发掘的失传秘密，它们将会揭示你的先祖在两万年前灭绝的原因。每前进一步，都有危险在等着你。
-生存工具
借助魔卓拉的机敏灵活来翻滚、躲闪、跳跃、飞檐走壁，并以前所未有的速度冲刺，从而躲避致命的有机体和有害的恶劣天气。利用你的迅捷反应力、丰富的武器库以及特殊技能来全力求生，应对各种各样的低级别威胁，乃至会逼你使出浑身解数的巨怪。
-借助环境来实现进化
启动你的扫描仪机器人，使用X射线视野来更仔细地检查生物和你身处的环境。揭晓隐藏道路和肉眼不可见的秘密区域，并勾勒出已探索的地图片区。
轰飞不怀好意的生物和有机体以吸收其普罗托浆——一种充满能量的生物质包块。在有机腔室内消耗此物质来实现变形，并将你的技能和武器进化至新的等级。

征服道路，磨练车技，成为顶尖驾驶高手！
在 Car Simulator: Driving School 中握紧方向盘，体验真实驾驶的乐趣！
探索广阔的开放世界，掌握高难度驾驶技巧，并通过系统化驾驶课程和专业考试检验自己的实力。
超过50种车辆、50项任务、五个各具特色的区域以及一条专用赛道，总有新的道路等待探索，新的挑战等你征服！
学习交通规则，掌握驾驶技巧。
每一位优秀的驾驶员都从基础开始！
参加精心设计的驾驶课程，考验你的精准操作、车辆控制能力和交通法规知识。穿梭于繁忙的街道，完成停车挑战，并通过专业驾驶考试，证明自己的驾驶实力。
50多种车辆，无限驾驶可能。
探索丰富多样的车辆阵容，每辆车都能带来独特的驾驶体验！
无论是在狭窄的城市街道中穿行，还是在宽阔的高速公路上驰骋，都需要调整驾驶风格，掌握不同车辆的操控特点，找到自己最喜爱的座驾。
自由探索，无拘无束。
畅游五个风格迥异的区域，体验独特的风景、道路布局和驾驶挑战。
享受开放世界的自由驾驶，探索风景优美的路线，或者前往专用赛道，进一步挑战自己的驾驶极限！
真实驾驶，沉浸体验。
感受灵敏的车辆操控、真实的换挡体验以及精心设计的驾驶机制，让每一段旅程都充满乐趣与成就感。
50项任务等待完成，无数道路等待探索，每一次驾驶都是提升技巧的新机会。
通过方向盘外设支持，将沉浸感提升到全新高度，让每次驾驶都拥有更精准的操控和更真实的体验！
学习规则，磨练车技，自由探索。
道路等你征服！发动引擎，系好安全带，迎接终极驾驶挑战。你的驾驶大师之旅，现在正式开始！

踏上前往奇幻世界特拉底亚的难忘旅程，在这里，宁静的农场生活与惊心动魄的冒险交织在一起！
你在宁静祥和的花绽村中成长，而如今，你的生活即将迎来巨大的改变。神秘的迷雾从回音森林中蔓延而出，野兽在夜幕下四处徘徊，奇异的灾害也开始威胁这片土地上的各个村庄。
探索广阔而充满生机的世界，发现隐藏的洞穴、遥远的岛屿、热闹的城镇，以及被遗忘已久的秘密。在旅途中，经营你的农场，饲养动物，收获作物，并打造一个属于自己的家园。在丰收女神的指引下，以及一路相遇的伙伴们的帮助下，你将找到成长、探索，以及帮助他人的全新方式。
随着季节更替，彼此之间的羁绊逐渐加深，隐藏在迷雾背后的真相也将慢慢浮现。在你帮助过的人们，以及陪伴你前行的伙伴们的支持下，你或许能够找到驱散回音森林迷雾的方法，让特拉底亚再次焕发生机！
• 恋爱与关系：结识10位独具魅力的恋爱对象——5位男性候选人和5位女性候选人。加深彼此之间的羁绊，体验感人至深的特别事件，并找到能够与你共度一生的理想伴侣。
• 动物伙伴系统：与各种各样的动物伙伴建立友谊，每种伙伴都拥有独特能力，帮助你展开探索。破坏障碍物，前往隐藏地点，并与你的伙伴一起发现特拉底亚的秘密。
• 全新的探索能力：跳跃、攀爬梯子、沿藤蔓向上攀爬，探索曾经无法到达的区域。结合你的移动能力与动物伙伴的特殊能力，尽情探索世界的每一个角落。
• 让大家都幸福起来：帮助村民，完成委托，并为特拉底亚的发展贡献力量，获得珍贵的快乐能量。收集的快乐能量越多，丰收女神就越能帮助恢复这片土地。
• 岛屿生活：收集航海图，发现遥远的岛屿。寻找隐藏的宝藏，探索全新的地点，并与只有在特拉底亚才能遇见的稀有动物成为朋友。
• 未驯服的荒野：荒野中生活着狼、熊、老虎以及其他野生动物。时刻保持警惕，避免被它们发现，否则你将失去收集到的物品，并回到自己的农场醒来。

editions.name: Harvest Moon®: Echoes of Teradea Bundle

critic.quote: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is a step up from its predecessor, introducing more vertical terrain and dense maps that make for rewarding exploration. Seeing the series continue to focus less on farming is an interesting pivot but I'm having a ton of fun with it.

I was initially hesitant to step back into the progenitor of the cozy farming genre, but I thoroughly enjoyed my time in Teradea. The open-world setting was a clear highlight, and finding exploration to be as deep and rewarding as the farming and relationship-building mechanics kept me far more invested than I expected from a game without combat. Echoes of Teradea provides a compelling gameplay lo

Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is another fine entry in the Harvest Moon series. It builds on the familiar formula of cultivating crops, tending to animals, gathering resources, building relationships and much more. There is plenty to keep you busy, and the new approach of weaving an overarching narrative into the experience works well. Unfortunately, the experience is marred by a very poor techn
Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea doesn’t break new ground in the genre, but it is still a cozy experience. There is some actual urgency in the game, but it does not run well on the Nintendo Switch 2.

s.desc:
再次踏入Radius：这片超现实而危机四伏的区域与外界隔绝，遍布致命实体、不断变化的异常现象和珍贵神器。探索、搜刮、完成任务，并在每次远征中存活下来，设法返回。
搭载PS VR2特色功能的VR生存射击游戏回归
《Into the Radius 2》登陆PS VR2，带来沉浸式生存第一人称射击体验，并针对头显提供眼动追踪注视点渲染、控制器与头显专属触觉反馈、3D音效、PlayStation活动和奖杯等功能。
掌握逼真的武器
每把枪械均拥有逼真的细节与独特操控手感。逐件自定义经典与现代武器，组合枪管、枪托、护木、瞄具、弹匣和配件，打造适合自己玩法的配置。保持枪械清洁并妥善维护，否则它们可能在最关键时刻卡壳。
准备好装备
所有装备均可亲手操作。按自己的想法配置胸挂、护甲背心、背包、收纳袋和枪套。根据机动性、操控性、舒适度或生存需求调整配装，再用喷漆个性化装备，从简洁纯色到多层迷彩图案。
直面RADIUS的阴影
与聪明的Mimics战斗：它们会搜寻、包抄、寻找掩护，并对所见所闻作出反应。设法在Fragments、隐形Phantoms、Creeps及其他扭曲威胁中生存下来；每种敌人都有独特行为和危险。
在异常现象中求生
Radius充满致命异常现象：它们可能爆裂成弹片、释放电击、压制附近光源、附着在你身上后爆炸，或将你猛烈推开。除非佩戴特殊的抗扭曲头部装备，否则扭曲区域可在数秒内将你撕碎。
规划路线，留意周围环境，并适应不断变化的Tide周期，才能活着回来。

critic.quote: Into the Radius 2's early access launch provides a solid foundation that balances the horror and realism elements well. Unfortunately, it's let down by bugs and issues aplenty. A lack of content also makes this hard to currently recommend, even for diehard fans of the first game, unless you're investing to help CM Games hopefully make a better game than its predecessor.

s.desc:
〈夺回Dr.Kirk作战〉结束后的一年。
拥有＂终极清洁能源＂与＂终极兵器＂两种特性的第三能量（Third Energy）。
这项计画已经脱离开发者Dr.Kirk之手，交由政府全面接管。
然而，＂事故＂再次发生——。
由于第三能量反应炉失控，规模远超上一次，令研究开发都市彻底消失。
政府为保护研究成果与相关人员，展开了救援行动。
利用尚未开发完成的＂时空转移（Time Gate）＂装置，将部队送往都市可能被转移到的时代。
——任务的最终结果，没有人能预测。
除了她──Regina。
本作的主角除了前作的＂Regina＂外，亦新增了＂Dylan＂。
可使用的武器种类更加丰富！登场的恐龙超过十种，同时袭来的恐龙数量亦加倍！
游戏舞台从前作以军事设施为中心的场景，拓展至白垩纪时代的世界。
丛林、洞窟、湖泊，被植物侵蚀的建筑等各种场景中，恐龙将不断向您袭来！

critic.quote: Graphically, Dino Crisis 2 boasts some of the best work the old PS will ever have to offer, with great CG flowing near seamlessly into the action the player controls.
I must say that Dino Crisis 2 is the most pleasing new experience in this whole Survival Genre yet.
One of the most refreshing takes on the third-person action shooter to date.
Offered a style of gameplay totally different than the original Dino Crisis. [Nov 2001, p.40]
Dino Crisis 2 serves up plenty of heart-thumping mayhem, awesome graphics and sound, and enough dinosaur bloodlust to keep even the most experienced dino hunters on their toes.
Great graphics and sound, tried-and-true gameplay, and wall-to-wall blasting mayhem make this a winner.

users.author: Stev3n
users.quote:
​Un pur chef-d'œuvre de l'ère PlayStation ! Dino Crisis 2 a su faire évoluer la formule vers un jeu d'action arcade frénétique, ultra dynamique et follement addictif.
​Entre le système de points pour acheter du meilleur armement, l'alternance parfaite entre Regina et Dylan, et les affrontements dantesques contre un bestiaire préhistorique spectaculaire, Capcom a livré un classique intemporel de la PS1. Une véritable pépite qu'on rejoue toujours avec le même plaisir !

users.quote: Played the first time when I was 10 yo. Now... 25 years later had to replay in pc emulator still really good and action packed

users.quote: One of the best dinosaur games of all time. Lots of species and action in a game that was part of my childhood.

users.author: Lino24
users.quote: Amazing game! Soundtracks and scenarios. Was a great experience to play this game.

s.desc:
在一次营救探险家同伴的行动中，你和搭档被困于南极的冰层之下。
再次醒来，你们对之前的遭遇毫无头绪，只发现自己身处神秘的诺切克工业设施内。全球危机即将爆发，主管凯瑟琳·鲍伊急需你们协助，接手其失踪科研团队未竟的工作。
沟通与协作
由于经常被迫分离，你们必须依靠对讲机来分享所见之景。合力拼凑线索，共同破解非对称谜题。
两位探险家各司其职
每位玩家各自承担不同的职责，掌握着不同的工具与信息。唯有各取所长，方能克服仅凭一人之力无法逾越的障碍。
探索 80 年代构想的未来
尽情探索诺切克工业。这座复古未来主义设施内隐藏着各种奇特科技与不为人知的秘密，更有怀旧合成配乐相伴。
揭开真相
越是深入诺切克工业，眼前越是疑团重重。你们为何会被带到此地？而之前来到这里的人又遭遇了什么？
唯有携手，方能决定“明日”的命运。

critic.quote: We Were Here Tomorrow have some of the smartest and thoughtfully designed puzzles the genre has to offer, set in a resplendent environment that’s a joy to explore, although they can be particularly challenging to solve. With some patience, grit and critical thinking, you may be able to solve them yet—although you may find yourself reaching for a guide at some point.

Puzzlers like this should have you laughing between putting your heads together, with silliness a reward for accomplishment. As it stands, the communication issues means there’s a good chance any laughter wouldn’t be heard, as you stand in silence, watching yet another pipe light up in a room you’ve spent far too much time in.

s.desc:
欢迎各位幸存者！
《深岩银河：幸存者》是一款单人类幸存者游戏。利用深岩银河集团的各式武器，在成群的致命异虫的攻势下，不断挖掘财宝、解锁强力升级，并活着逃出生天。以一矮人之力，对抗整个霍克斯星球！
结合挖矿的子弹狂飙体验
消灭异虫、升级装备，一往无前地深入霍克斯的致命洞穴。收集并搭建各类威力惊人的武器，在疾风骤雨般的战斗中扫射一波接一波的外星怪物，深入挖掘潜藏在矿洞岩体之中的各类宝矿。作为类幸存者游戏，你完全不用担心应该盯着岩体挖矿，还是盯着虫群射击——在你仓皇逃窜或挖到手软的同时，武器将自动朝着对的方向喷吐弹幕。
正如《深岩银河》中一样，游戏的洞穴和敌人波次均由程序生成，每个任务都独一无二，颇具趣味。
完成任务，逐渐变强
向深处进发，矿工！一旦离开空投舱，迈入令人压抑的黑暗，你便是孤军奋战。在逐渐凶猛的异虫攻势下，完成集团下发的任务，并及时返回空降舱，由此反复。一边逐渐探索星球深处，一边不断提升实力，顽强存活至任务结束，带着沉甸甸的战利品满载而归。
以全新视角探索深岩宇宙
以崭新的单人游戏体验，探索深受数百万玩家喜爱的深岩银河宇宙！在俯视角下体验各个任务，探索你从未见过的霍克斯洞穴。灰胡子老手想必能认出许多来自《深岩银河》的内容，而如果你是刚加入的绿胡子菜鸟，我们向你致以诚挚的欢迎！很高兴你选择加入我们。你会喜欢这里的——毕竟这可是管理层的要求。
挖到手软，赚到盆满！

critic.quote: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is the most genuine threat to Vampire Survivor's rule yet.
Vampire Survivors is no longer the king of the genre.

Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor doesn’t necessarily revolutionize its genre, but it doesn’t need to. With this entry in the action roguelike autoshooter genre, Funday Games has created a delightfully enjoyable game that will keep you coming back for more.

Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is more than just another Vampire Survivors clone—it’s a faithful spin on the co-op classic that carries over its humor, class personality, and suffocating cave atmosphere. The lack of camaraderie stings, and the grind and balance issues get rough in the endgame, but the core loop of digging, shooting, and upgrading never stops being fun. For fans of either genre, it’s
A fine addition to a young genre, Survivor adds smart twists, most notably its level-based structure; however, unlike the mainline Deep Rock Galactic, it’s single-player only.

Auto Shooter, set in the proven Dwarven Universe, already offers a complete package, with hordes of creatures and rare resources to discover underground. However, the difficulty level is high, and the repetition of biomes and missions unnecessarily and artificially extends the game's scope.

users.author: mdonohue
users.quote: By FAR the best game in this genre. Have played since early access and it only gets better and better. Would highly recommend

users.author: Ranchs
users.quote: The game is addictive, fun, I didn't find a bug for now, extremely exhaustive but stay simple, no need to buy things. It's great when played with friends

users.author: SlimShadow
users.quote:
Love it.

The variety is huge.
Although it may seem excessively difficult at first, it is quite easy to become extremely **** once you understand the process, it becomes almost too easy. But until you reach that point, you will have a lot of fun.

That's why I only give it an 8/10, because the replay value leaves something to be desired for me, as it just becomes too easy.

s.desc:
踏入一个被疯狂吞噬的世界，每一次遭遇都是一场为了生存而进行的殊死搏斗。
《Mortal Sin》是一款残酷的第一人称 Roguelike 游戏，将迅捷、拳拳到肉的近战战斗与近乎无限的可重复游玩性完美融合。掌握毁灭性的连招，击溃源源不断的敌人，在不断变化、充满秘密、强力战利品与难以言喻恐怖的地下城中杀出一条血路。
没有任何两次冒险会完全相同。探索程序生成的世界，完成随机任务，并解锁不断扩充的独特职业阵容。每个职业都拥有专属武器、技能和截然不同的战斗风格。无论是挥舞巨剑粉碎敌人，还是手持双枪横扫梦魇，每一次挑战都将带来全新的生存方式。
凭借极具冲击力的漫画风艺术风格以及可完全自定义的视觉模式，《Mortal Sin》将带来一场充满风格且毫不留情的噩梦之旅。在这里，技巧决定一切，而自负只会带来死亡。

critic.quote: Mortal Sin is a skeletal roguelite, but the surprisingly meaty combat goes a long way to making up for that.

This was because of Its fun and addictive combat, appealing graphics and well designed enemies and areas, just to name a few. There aren't many games that I review which I want to go back and put more hours in, however with Mortal Sin I can't help myself but want to experience more of th

Mortal Sin is a hidden roguelike gem that combines fast-paced combat, and striking visuals. Not for everyone, but its intense gameplay and replayability make it unforgettable for those willing to dive in. [Recommended]

s.desc:
《9 Years of Shadows（九年之影）》是由 Halberd Studios 带来的美丽横向卷轴类银河战士恶魔城游戏。
勇敢的女战士欧罗巴（Europa）决定在世界被黑暗吞噬之前，潜入古老的大型机械巨人塔洛斯（Talos）体内，彻底切断黑暗的根源。与因诅咒而变异的怪物战斗、结识众多个性鲜明的音乐家，并揭开夺走世界色彩的诅咒背后的真相吧。
【特色】
横向卷轴动作游戏。在没有能量的状态下受到攻击时会减少 1 点生命值。生命值耗尽则游戏结束。若从游戏结束画面选择继续游戏，将会从上次储存的地点重新开始。
拥抱阿皮诺（Apino）即可补充能量。此外，也能发射光弹来摧毁阻挡去路的黑暗结晶。

critic.quote: If any part of 9 Years of Shadows looks appealing to you, you owe it to yourself to pick it up. This is an amazing game made by a heretofore unknown team, and I can only hope that Halberd Studios has plans for a follow-up. They deserve to be showered in praise, and this game deserves your time and attention.

Nine Years of Shadows is a good Metroidvania with an impressive presentation and intriguing world. Gameplay mechanics will be instantly familiar to any genre fans and easy to understand for newcomers. There aren’t too many surprises in the narrative but it is imbued with a sense of optimism that kept me engaged. I wanted more variety for combat encounters and a smoother difficulty curve for the bo
An enjoyable, entry level metroidvania. It looks, sounds and plays great even if it is a little on the short side.

Hopefully, post-launch patches will arrive to remedy this experience to its best possible iteration because it deserves it. Underneath it all, 9 years of Shadows is a fantastic time assumedly hampered by developmental circumstances.
9 Years of Shadows can be frustrating in places, but if you’re looking for a 2D Metroidvania with solid combat, enjoyable platforming, and beautiful world design, it ticks all of those boxes.

9 Years of Shadows clearly shows that Halberd Studios' underlying ideas are good, but their development hasn't been flawless. Despite a particularly lively background imagery, which mixes different influences in an interesting way, staged with considerable care in the graphics department, this short adventure fails to exploit its full potential.

users.author: gimmesomethruth
users.quote: Although is a short game, what the games offers is a classic experience that reminded me a lot of Aria of Sorrow and Megaman Zero. The music is phenomenal and the backgrounds are breathtaking.

The animation is amazing, the way Europa's dress seems to flow is stunning.

s.desc:
MXGP 官方授权的真实呈现：
扮演您最喜爱的车手，在 MXGP 和 MX2 组别的全部 19 条本赛季官方赛道上尽情驰骋。每一个弯道、每一次飞跃以及赛道的每一个路段，都以无与伦比的还原度进行了重新制作，带您身临其境地融入官方赛季的核心。
画面革命：
MXGP 系列首次凭借全新的 Unreal Engine 5（虚幻引擎 5）全力加速。其结果如何？一场重新定义该类型游戏标准的壮丽画面革命。光影效果、材质纹理和环境细节将令您叹为观止。比以往任何时候都更加流畅、自然的选手动作，将让您感觉自己仿佛正亲自跨骑在摩托车上。
赛道赋予生命：掌控动态地形形变
这是彻底改变游戏规则的全新核心特色！有史以来第一次，地面会对每一次车轮的驶过做出实时做出反应。压出深车辙、开辟全新的行车路线并征服它们。赛道在不断变化，由于其对物理效果的影响是真实存在的，您必须不断调整自己以适应多变的轨迹，这将极大地考验您的天赋和适应能力。
铸就你传奇的游戏模式：
在 Compound（自由练习场）中自由磨练您的压车（scrubs）和甩尾（whips）技巧，或者在 Time Trial（时光挑战赛）中追求极限单圈速度。
渴望竞争？在 Quick Race（快速随机赛）中，与 20 名凶悍的车手同场竞技，抢占杆位（holeshot），并在或长或短的单局比赛中奋力捍卫自己的名次。在 Championship（锦标赛）模式中，圆梦您的理想赛季并夺取红盘（red plate）。
最后，当 Online Multiplayer（多人在线联机）的起跑门落下时，通过全球排行榜向世界展示谁才是这个星球上最顶尖的车手。

critic.quote:
MXGP 26 is one of those games that are extremely appealing for fans of the genre, and even someone who’s not into MXGP will find plenty to love here. The championship mode is the highlight, and then you also have time trials, grand prix and other modes to keep you company for a few dozen hours. Plus, there’s also a multiplayer which, when works well, is extremely fun and enjoyable.
The lack of ch

MXGP 26 feels like it came straight out of 2006, and I mean that in the most positive way possible. It’s missing a few pieces and there are some rough edges to iron out, but the foundations are all there and they work remarkably well. If your goal is to kick up some dirt and soar over jumps, Artefacts Studio’s game won’t disappoint. If you’re looking for a more detailed and feature-rich experience

MXGP 26 is a fine, serviceable motocross sim that checks the necessary boxes for official licensing and baseline physics, but it doesn’t push the genre forward in any meaningful way. It works well as a reliable pick-up-and-play title for handheld devices like the Steam Deck provided you don’t mind squinting at the UI but racing veterans looking for a true next-gen leap may find it a bit too playin

There is just one music track on the main menu—nothing more—which is perfect for anyone wanting to play a podcast or their favorite playlist in the background; however, those looking to immerse themselves in the adventure have to settle for the roar of the exhaust and little else.

users.quote: This is the MXGP game we have been waiting for for so long. The track deformation is next level. MXGP26 is a solid game.

s.desc:
现在预约《STRANGER THAN HEAVEN》，即可获得预购特典：游戏内武器“短刀·影切”。
包含内容
·武器“短刀·影切”
这是一个关于无处安身的男人们，为了寻找归宿而战斗了50年的故事。
1915年，旧金山。故事从一个少年在深夜的港口城市偷偷潜入一艘神秘的船开始。
少年名叫大东真。
他的父亲是美国人，母亲是日本人。
因自身亚洲人的样貌，大东遭到了严重的迫害，
如今父母双亡、孑然一身的他，决定前往母亲的故乡——日本。
虽然在美国无处立足，但日本一定会有自己的容身之处。
大东怀揣着这样的信念，只身一人登上了那艘船。在船上那场可谓命中注定的邂逅，彻底改变了他此后的人生轨迹。
在日本等待着大东的究竟是什么？在经历了漫长旅途之后，他最后的归宿又会是何处……
■五个时代、五座城市
故事的舞台，是以日本各个时代的真实城市为蓝本创造的“或许存在过的日本”。
1915年，坐拥世界最大规模铸造设备的钢铁厂所在地、大街小巷满是血气方刚的务工人员的福冈·小仓。
1929年，拥有日本最大的海军工厂、深受黑道势力影响的广岛·吴。
1943年，西日本最繁华的娱乐街区，世界局势紧张背景下的大阪·南区。
1951年，在战后成为了日本旅游景点代名词的静冈·热海。
以及1965年，至今仍是日本最繁华，也是最混乱的娱乐街区，东京·新宿。
■最自由、最本能、最极限的暴力
这是一个所有人都为了活下去而拼死挣扎的时代。
通过战斗系统，体验在这充斥着暴力的动荡年代，为了生存而展开的激烈搏斗。
化身大东，随心所欲地操纵左半身和右半身，身临其境地进行战斗。
用刺拳打出强力一击，或使用蓄力攻击将敌人击飞，趁敌人站立不稳之际将其摔倒在地，压在身下大揍特揍，暴力到近乎残忍地痛扁敌人。
不仅如此，还可以单手挡下敌人的攻击并立刻施以还击。通过观察敌人动作，自由自在地创造出决定性的攻击瞬间。
此外，还能强化并使用菜刀、锤子、日本刀等多种武器，在与各个时代的暴徒的对决中杀出一条血路。
■大东真，作为策划人的另一面
教导大东如何在日本生存下去的师父发掘出了大东的音乐天赋。此后，大东不仅亲自献唱，还开始以“策划人”的身份参与策划演出活动。
为了进一步扩大演出规模，大东在街头四处打听，寻找并签下优秀的歌手与乐手。
为寻找作曲灵感而前往街头，听取扫帚声、鼾声、蒸汽机车声、动物的叫声乃至战斗时对手发出的声音。把各种各样的声音纳入作曲的参考，将其排列组合，创作出属于自己的原创音乐。
通过确定曲目、乐队编排、成员分工来策划演出，精心设计灯光颜色等舞台效果，将演出呈现在观众面前。不断在各地举办演出、吸引观众，书写大东作为策划人的传奇故事。

重返《泰坦之旅》系列经典的神话设定，在设计全面焕新的古希腊世界对战传奇怪物。复仇女神涅墨西斯已经彻底失控。她对命运本身构成了严重威胁，任何胆敢反抗之人，都会受到她的无情神罚。拿起武器，与众神并肩作战，最终成长为足以阻止涅墨西斯的强大英雄。《SpellForce 3》原班人马再度出击，亲手打造了这款为全新一代神话英雄设计的动作RPG游戏。
神话与怪物横行的土地
踏上史诗般壮丽的宏大冒险，前往风景绝美的海滩、宁静雅致的希腊神庙、战痕累累的平原、幽灵触摸的沼泽、变幻莫测的森林、荒芜辽阔的沙漠、怪物横行的高山，更有凡人不敢踏足的神秘领域。与来自希腊神话和《泰坦之旅》原作的经典生物对战——鱼人、半人马、狮鹫、猪人、马头鱼尾怪，自动机、萨堤尔、鹰身妖、独眼巨人，不一而足。前路险阻重重，你能否向世界证明，英雄时代还远未结束？
走进未知的奥德赛之旅
《泰坦之旅2》配有精心设计的独特剧情，着重打造世界探索体验，无数秘密与谜团等你揭开。传奇怪物在隐秘角落游走，怪异法器仍充盈着远古魔法；下个转角，也许就会有神明站在你的面前。每处废墟都有自己的秘密，每座雕像都有自己的故事。充满生命力与神秘感的难忘城镇遍布世界各地。你仔细聆听的每一次对话，在路上发现的每一条线索，都可能指向某个惊人的真相。这，是专属于你的冒险之旅。
勇者方能尽享荣耀
随着旅程的不断推进，你将解锁强大的能力、使用史诗中的绝世神兵。然而，敌人也非等闲之辈——运用躲闪与反击克制敌人的攻击，抓住时机，用狂风骤雨般的招式将其打倒。你可通过仪式控制游戏的难度，极具深度的角色自定义系统也将献上无穷的重玩乐趣。
FEATURES:
• 将两种专精合而为一，组成你自己的独特职业定位。参透两种专精的强项与弱项，不断探索各种组合，为你的角色打造最强出装。
• 每件物品都有自己的功能，每个角色职业都有众多选项，只等你找到自己的“神装”。
• 敌人将组成不同阵营、通力合作，将其独特技巧与能力结合；大敌当前，片刻轻忽也能让你功败垂成。使用极具深度的角色出装系统，充分利用自己的各项能力技巧！
• 辽阔壮美的平原、深邃幽暗的洞穴，处处都可能暗藏玄机。使用众神之力揭示秘密地点，穿越高低错落的关卡地形，感受游戏设计中蕴藏的爱与心血。
• 传统希腊音乐与现代交响元素有机结合，组成沉浸感十足的背景音乐，更有令人难忘的史诗主题乐曲，伴随玩家探索《泰坦之旅2》的独特世界。

欢迎来到阳光普照、丧尸横行的亚利桑那州。
磨利砍刀，装填好霰弹枪，再叫上你的伙伴。荣获嘉奖、口碑爆棚的《Arizona Sunshine®》系列，如今带着劲爆的第三人称玩法和炎炎烈日下的合作激战模式，再度与世界各地的玩家见面。
《Arizona Sunshine®》延续了系列作品标志性的硬核战斗风格，同时承接了《Arizona Sunshine® VR 2》癫狂又意外感人的剧情故事。无论是剧情驱动的单人模式，还是混乱刺激的合作模式，玩家都能以全新方式在这令人心跳加速、血肉横飞而又充满黑色幽默的末日世界中艰难求生。每一场遭遇都可能瞬息万变、险象环生。

巴迪不只是你忠心耿耿，患难与共的四足伙伴，更是末日世界里最乖的“好狗狗”。它非常乐意与你并肩作战，一同将那些难缠的弗雷德们撕个粉碎。本作中，巴迪将首次在合作模式中成为可操控角色，为你解锁一种全新的末日体验。

• 探索烈日炙烤的末日世界，感受黑色幽默与混乱激战，并与无处不在的弗雷德们“打”成一片

I loved every second of the 30+ hours I poured into Wandering Sword. In a year filled with so many critically acclaimed RPGs like Baldur’s Gate 3, Starfield, Final Fantasy XVI, and Sea of Stars, I could easily see a smaller, PC-only release like Wandering Sword getting lost in the shuffle. That would be an absolute tragedy, as Wandering Sword delivered one of the best gaming experiences I’ve had a

Wandering Sword is a journey into an ancient China to be explored from top to bottom, meeting wonderful characters and engaging in pitched battles in which tactics, party members and character build are crucial. Progression is quite fast-paced and debunks the cliché that would have Eastern games to be based on grinding. The main campaign is fairly linear, but there are enough side quests that prov

Wandering Sword offers an adventure through a Chinese-inspired land of mystical martial arts that is elevated by its aesthetics and setting while being backed up by an engaging tactical combat system. While it doesn’t do anything revolutionary, it will be worth the time invested for players attracted to the material.

In a time when absolutely massive blockbuster RPGs are sucking up all the oxygen in the room, Wandering Sword stands out as an amazing independent RPG that crushes every goal it sets out to achieve. s.desc:
预购任意版本的《Until Dawn 2》即可获得Dr. Hill的独家服装和游戏内收藏品，为您的游戏体验增添别样风格。
预购奖励包括¹：
• Dr. Hill -《Until Dawn》经典服装和摇头公仔游戏内收藏品
• Dr. Hill -《Until Dawn 2》岛屿服装和摇头公仔游戏内收藏品
版本包含：
•《Until Dawn 2》
一群暗自心存怀疑的捉鬼者，因一次社交媒体恶作剧意外走红，获得了电视节目的合约。新工作将他们带到偏远荒岛上的一座废弃度假村——一名女子口中充斥着恶魔和种种灵异事件的地方。而这场冒险，或许会让他们的电视首秀一炮而红。
互动式恐怖体验
踏上小岛，投身取材自经典和现代悲剧、暴力及超自然复仇传说的灵异故事。这群年轻的网红主播能否熬过惊魂之夜？他们的命运由您掌控……
您的选择至关重要
在这段扭曲离奇的故事中探索众多路径，您的每一个选择都可能改变前进方向，将角色引向安全……或死亡。谨慎做出对话选择，时刻保持大脑飞速运转，并随时迎接各种意想不到的变数，您的故事将一步步走向多个惊心动魄的结局之一。丰富的选择意味着每一次重玩都可能经历层层转折，并最终导向截然不同的结局走向。
极致拟真
探索风光旖旎的热带小岛，穿行于众多废弃设施之间，借助PlayStation®5的强大功能，每一细节都展现得淋漓尽致、栩栩如生。勇敢踏入不祥的阴影深处，搜寻蛛丝马迹，留意交谈时细微的面部表情变化，并仔细研究精心设计、充满环境叙事感的场景。
恐惧的力量
通过DualSense®无线控制器的触觉反馈和自适应扳机，以感官获得全方位的恐惧体验。仔细端详手中的物品和线索、感受肾上腺素飙升时心脏砰砰作响，并在每次遭遇超自然现象、指尖战栗不已时对抗内心的恐惧。

《地铁2039》是 4A Games 推出的又一款里程碑式第一人称射击游戏，依旧延续了广受好评的重叙事风格。后末日之下，踏上一场直抵莫斯科黑暗腹地的苦痛之旅，在事关地铁存亡的争斗中寻找出路。
时间来到 2039 年。
莫斯科饱受核战争荼毒，仅剩的幸存者转移至地底的地铁隧道，却身陷旷日持久的残酷内战，如此生活了四分之一个世纪。如今，终于出现了一位能够团结所有力量的领袖——不是别人，正是那位有着“猎人”名号、以狂热著称的斯巴达游骑兵。
可和平却并未真正降临。猎人的“新帝国”政权通过宣传手段和恐惧心理实行统治，以发动新战争、对抗地表某个黑暗的可怖敌人为名奴役民众。
城市之外的无垠荒野中，离群索居的“陌路人”深受噩梦困扰，连清醒时都难逃其猛烈攻势。当往事阴魂不散地找上门来，他也只能结束自我放逐，一路深入莫斯科的残垣断壁，去往那个他曾发誓永不踏足的地方……
地铁。
穿行于这片残酷又美丽的土地，沉浸式体验探索、生存、战斗与潜行交织的单人游戏剧情，独自品味史上最震撼的“地铁”冒险。
灵感源自德米特里·格鲁霍夫斯基的全球畅销书籍《地铁》三部曲

立即预购，抢先解锁幸存者套装
标准版
- 《古墓丽影：亚特兰蒂斯遗迹》本体版
在《古墓丽影：亚特兰蒂斯遗迹》中迎接终极冒险，再次体验1996年动作冒险类型开山之作。
你将扮演劳拉·克劳馥，凭借过人智慧与矫健身手，探索那些遗忘在时间尽头的奇异遗迹——从秘鲁的丛林，古希腊的废墟，埃及的沙漠，乃至那座被神话笼罩的地中海神秘岛屿。穿越危机四伏的场景，破解致命机关，对抗凶猛的掠食者，追寻那件拥有无穷力量的神器“司祭盎”的碎片。
无论你是系列老手还是刚刚进入劳拉的世界，都可以享受《古墓丽影：亚特兰蒂斯遗迹》中由虚幻5引擎打造的震撼视觉效果，现代化的游戏设计以及全新的隐藏惊喜，传承劳拉·克劳馥的冒险精神，展开伟大故事的新篇章。

于预购期间（至2027年2月15日23:59止）购买本作的玩家，可于开始游戏后，从洛亚努镇或缪尔斯港其中一处的宝箱中取得以下装备。
■套装内容
·塔吉亚娜的储钱罐
某位商家孩子的储钱罐。名声阶级为2以下时，战斗后获得的金币提升10%。
·罗宾的英雄指南
记载着怪杰罗宾英雄心得的书籍。名声阶级为2以下时，全体成员于战斗后获得的技术点提升10%。
1995年于日本创下百万销量纪录的《浪漫沙加3》，如今推出完全重制版。
无论是系列作的粉丝，还是首次游玩的玩家，都能尽情享受本作的乐趣。
■故事
……死蚀……
每三百年降临一次的灾难，
会夺走该年诞生的所有生命。
唯独“宿命之子”除外。
距离上一次死蚀过了十余年后，洛亚努侯国爆发了叛乱。
偶然遇见公主莫妮卡的伙伴们成功平定了叛乱，
卻也因此揭開新的陰謀。
曾经肆虐世界的魔王麾下“四魔贵族”，
正企图开启深渊之门……
为了阻止世界走向毁灭，
受到宿命指引的八人之旅就此展开。
■角色
从八位主角中选择一位展开冒险。
·尤里安：充满正义感的西侬村年轻人。
·托马斯：出身名门本特家的青年。
·米迦勒：统治洛亚努侯国的年轻领主。
·哈里特：以“龙卷风”之名闻名的佣兵。
·莎拉：西侬村个性内向的少女。
·艾莲：西侬村个性好强的女性。莎拉的姐姐。
·莫妮卡：洛亚努侯国的公主。
·卡特丽娜：侍奉洛亚努侯家的贵族女性。
此外，还有来自各种不同职业与种族的伙伴登场。
等待着你的是与超过二十位角色相遇的旅程。
■画面
承袭原版小林智美笔下插画与像素图的魅力，同时由Yoshiro Ambe重新设计角色。
城镇、迷宫等场地也全面以3D重新打造。
■自由剧本
要从哪段故事开始，又要依照什么顺序挑战四魔贵族。
玩家的选择将改变冒险的样貌。
请尽情体验因自由探索与选择而诞生的，只属于自己的故事。
■战斗、成长系统
保留战斗中领悟新技能的“闪悟”以及可带来各种效果的“阵形”等经典系统，并采用角色依序行动的时间线战斗，与伙伴携手施展的“连携技”也将使战斗更加热血激昂。
■难度
可从简单、普通、原版三种难度中选择。
简单适合想以剧情为主的玩家，普通适合熟悉RPG的玩家，原版则推荐给想体验忠实重现原作高难度战斗的玩家。
■音乐、语音
原作音乐由伊藤賢治操刀，本作的乐曲重新编曲亦由他亲自统筹。
玩家可于选项中自由切换重编版BGM与原版BGM。
此外，过场事件支持全语音，语音皆是为本作全新录制。

你听说过深夜电视吗？
主角转学来到新学校，校园里流传着关于“深夜电视”的都市传说。
同时，雾天清晨出现了倒吊的尸体。
追查这两个谜团时，主角一行人面前出现了名为“暗影”的另一个自己。

踏上追寻真相的旅程吧！

你将作为故事的主角暂住到日本的乡下小镇稻羽市，在这里开始一段高中生活，度过无可替代的一年时光。要学习还是要参加社团活动，是去唱卡拉OK还是选择恋爱，如何度过多彩的每一天，完全由你决定。

■新增唤起旧日回忆的剧情
晴朗的天空、夕阳下的河堤、被雨水打湿的路面。稻羽市带着往日余温的风景将以精致的画面呈现出来。在寻找案件线索的同时，不妨也听听镇上的居民有什么困扰吧。有时也会在交流中萌生“情谊”。你与他人结下的“情谊”必将化为你的“力量”。

踏入这款沉浸式开放世界动作角色扮演游戏，成为你想要成为的那种英雄。在这里，你的每一次选择都会改变未来的旅程。名声高于一切，幸福结局需要用双手争取。
传奇游戏系列的新篇章
《神鬼寓言》以惊艳新作重启人气系列。你将扮演这一时代里出现的第一位英雄，探索生机勃勃的阿尔比昂大陆。这里充满了奇特的人物、黑色幽默，还有小鸡......很多很多只鸡。这一作不仅仅是对前作的怀旧，更是在一片美丽而鲜活的开放世界里展开的全新篇章。
成为你想要成为的那种英雄
自定义英雄外观，挥舞强大的武器，在近战、远程与魔法战斗之间灵活切换。迎战强盗、野兽和各种生物，还有全新敌人以及祟精、狍狡、巨魔等玩家钟爱的经典怪物。你的名声将随着你的力量一同增长。
打造非凡人生
在激烈的战斗之外，你还可以在这片生生不息的世界里展开奇妙人生，雕刻自我。成为房东或铁匠，赚得盆满钵满；与村民来一场（或者三场）浪漫邂逅，生养一群孩子，看着你的名声与日俱增，代代相传。成为英雄的感觉有点像是成为明星......不过是那种会佩戴刀剑、偶尔会与喷火巨鸡战斗的明星。
你的选择将改变世界
在阿尔比昂，英雄的名声就是一切。高尚的功绩，或是不太道德的决定，都会影响你与每一位村民的关系，甚至可能会影响你周围的世界。谁的意见最重要？选择权在你手中......不过，相应的后果也会由你承担。“成为英雄意味着什么”，这个答案就由你来撰写。
幸福结局需要用双手争取。

■透过照片级写实图像来体验壮阔故事
以仿佛照片般写实并细致呈现的广大宇宙为舞台，描绘左右人类未来的壮阔故事。
玩家将化身螺旋高达驾驶“雷克斯”，和搭档哈啰“惟”一同邂逅各具魅力的角色，一起挺身面对启示带来的威胁。
■体验畅快、高机动的立体动作战斗
在场地上自在驰骋，活用机动力灵活搭配从地面和空中使出的攻击吧。

可获得两款猫猫专用饰品。
[早期购买特典]

可获得两款猫猫专用饰品，以及可在游戏前期派上用场的消耗道具。
【组合内容】
·药屋素雅配饰套装
新增猫猫专用配饰套装，内含两件饰品。
·新手配药助力礼包
新增配药材料包，可用于调配游戏前期任务所需的道具。
那帖药，终将化为毒。
【关于本作】
以药为引，以推理破局——揭开一切真相的宫廷推理奇谭。
“五大谜团”与“五重诅咒”相互交织，谱写出《药屋少女的呢喃》的全新故事。
怪异频发，阴谋迭起，在后宫、花街与市井间不断蔓延。
出身花街的药师少女猫猫循迹追查，最终所揭开的“真假皇弟”真相，究竟是——
### 证据搜集与推理
通过对话与实地调查获得的零散线索将记录于手记中，并在梳理案情环节整合为清晰的关系图。推理环节需出示与组合证据，在审慎抉择中体验步步惊心的博弈。
### 采集药材与配药
在地图中采集素材，混合药材并斟酌配比以完成配药。素材的种类与品质不仅影响配药小游戏的难度，也将左右最终成品的药效。
【剧情概要】
花街的药师猫猫初入后宫成为侍女后不久，后宫接连发生了被称作“五大谜团”的离奇事件——
没有面孔的宦官、夜夜传出哀声的库房、一夜间被染红的衣物……
种种异象频生，一时间，后宫人心惶惶。
受后宫管事壬氏所托，猫猫开始着手调查“五大谜团”。
凭借药理知识与敏锐观察，她善用配药与交涉之术，一步步搜集线索，破解谜案。
在回家省亲途中，猫猫结识了江湖艺人冠宇。一纸药方的机缘，却让她卷入冠宇深藏的“烦恼”之中。
时光流转，子之一族的叛乱方平，王都却再起波澜。“五重诅咒”的传闻悄然蔓延，终至血案发生。
猫猫偶然行经案发现场，竟亲眼目睹“蒙面皇弟”现身。
壬氏虽矢口否认，但王都之中流言四起，甚嚣尘上，更出现公然拥立“蒙面皇弟”的神秘集团，王都局势愈发扑朔迷离。
那位“蒙面皇弟”的真实身份究竟为何？五大谜团与五重诅咒之间，又暗藏怎样的因缘？
一段牵涉尘封禁忌秘史的宏大故事，即将拉开序幕——

■预购特典
·召唤魔晶石：机械陆行鸟＆莫古力
赌上星球未来，与萨菲罗斯展开最终决战。
足以毁灭星球的陨石带来威胁，巨大的星球守护者兵器即将觉醒，战火也愈发激烈。在迈向终焉的世界中，克劳德与伙伴们将挺身而出，为了拯救星球，也为了替这场漫长的战斗画下句点。
本作是“FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE”项目三部曲的完结篇，将以系列史上最大的规模，描绘壮阔的冒险。驾驶飞空艇翱翔天际，探索广阔世界，与伙伴们一同挑战全面进化的战斗。未知的旅程，终将抵达终点。
所有命运，都将在此交汇。
■驾驶飞空艇翱翔天际，展开前所未有的冒险
搭乘飞空艇海温德在空中四处航行，自由地探索广大的世界。
亲自选择降落地点，使用降落伞从空中一跃而下。穿梭于壮丽的大地、都市与秘境之间，展开全新的冒险。
■伙伴们终于全员集结
全新可操作角色文森特·瓦伦丁与希德·海温德也将参战。
擅长华丽枪战动作的文森特，以及能熟练运用长枪、在地面与空中灵活作战的希德加入后，个性鲜明的伙伴们终于全数集结。各角色截然不同的战斗风格与能力，也将大幅拓展战术选择。
■更加精炼的动作与战略性
融合即时动作与指令选择的系列独有战斗系统再次进化。
玩家可一边切换操作角色，一边选择指令，灵活运用强大的能力、联手招式与召唤兽的力量来迎战强敌。与巨大的星球守护者兵器之间的战斗，也将以前所未有的规模呈现。
■丰富的自定义要素
通过武器、装备、技能与魔晶石的搭配组合，玩家可自由地自定义角色的能力。
此外，全新系统“战术衣”可通过让角色穿上专属服装，解锁全新的能力与技能，进一步拓展各角色的战斗方式。除了享受外观变化的乐趣，也能打造专属于自己的战术与游玩风格。

击溃诸神，为艾尔塔奋起而战
你被族人选中，踏上寻找失落神明的旅程，却意外流落到一颗危机四伏的星球。归途已断，你只能与新结识的龙形伙伴并肩作战，奋力杀出重围。重创强敌，击败诸神，无论前方有何阻碍，皆以战斗闯破重重险阻，一路杀出生天

- 追随先祖足迹，习得全新战斗招式与灵巧特技，与艾尔塔一同磨练技艺，不断变强
- 击溃迫害并将族人流放数百年的诸神，帮助艾尔塔完成复仇，为更加美好的未来开辟道路
